verses.1:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the tent of meeting, on the first day of the second month, in the second year after they went out from the land of Egypt, saying,
verses.1:2: "Take the tally of the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, every male by the head.
verses.1:3: From twenty years old and upward, everyone in Israel who goes out to war, you and Aaron shall register them according to their divisions.
verses.1:4: Furthermore, one man for each tribe shall be with you, each one the head of his fathers' house.
verses.1:5: Now these are the names of the men who shall stand with you: for Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur;
verses.1:6: for Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai;
verses.1:7: for Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab;
verses.1:8: for Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar;
verses.1:9: for Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon;
verses.1:10: for the sons of Joseph: for Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud; for Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur;
verses.1:11: for Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni;
verses.1:12: for Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai;
verses.1:13: for Asher, Pagiel son of Ochran;
verses.1:14: for Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel;
verses.1:15: for Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan."
verses.1:16: These were those summoned from the assembly, leaders of their fathers' tribes; they were heads of the thousands of Israel.
verses.1:17: Then Moses and Aaron took these men who had been specified by name.
verses.1:18: And they convened the entire assembly on the first day of the second month, and they declared their lineage according to their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, by the head.
verses.1:19: As the LORD had commanded Moses, so he registered them in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.1:20: Now the sons of Reuben, Israel's firstborn, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, by the head, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:21: those registered of them, for the tribe of Reuben, were forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.1:22: Of the sons of Simeon, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, those registered of him, by the count of names, by the head, every male from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:23: those registered of them, for the tribe of Simeon, were fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.1:24: Of the sons of Judah, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:25: those registered of them, for the tribe of Judah, were seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.1:26: Of the sons of Issachar, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:27: those registered of them, for the tribe of Issachar, were fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.1:28: Of the sons of Zebulun, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:29: those registered of them, for the tribe of Zebulun, were fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.1:30: Of the sons of Joseph, of the sons of Ephraim, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:31: those registered of them, for the tribe of Ephraim, were forty thousand five hundred.
verses.1:32: Of the sons of Manasseh, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:33: those registered of them, for the tribe of Manasseh, were thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.1:34: Of the sons of Benjamin, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:35: those registered of them, for the tribe of Benjamin, were thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.1:36: Of the sons of Gad, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:37: those registered of them, for the tribe of Gad, were forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.1:38: Of the sons of Dan, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:39: those registered of them, for the tribe of Dan, were sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.1:40: Of the sons of Asher, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:41: those registered of them, for the tribe of Asher, were forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.1:42: The sons of Naphtali, their lineages, by their clans, by their fathers' houses, by the count of names, from twenty years old and upward, everyone who goes out to war:
verses.1:43: those registered of them, for the tribe of Naphtali, were fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.1:44: These are those registered, whom Moses and Aaron and the leaders of Israel registered, twelve men; each one was for his fathers' house.
verses.1:45: Thus all those registered of the sons of Israel, by their fathers' houses, from twenty years old and upward, everyone in Israel who goes out to war:
verses.1:46: all those registered came to six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.1:47: But the Levites, by their fathers' tribe, were not registered among them.
verses.1:48: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.1:49: "Only the tribe of Levi you shall not register, and you shall not take their tally among the sons of Israel.
verses.1:50: But as for you, appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the testimony, and over all its articles, and over everything that belongs to it. They themselves shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, and they shall minister to it, and they shall camp around the tabernacle.
verses.1:51: When the tabernacle sets out, the Levites shall take it down, and when the tabernacle camps, the Levites shall raise it up; and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death.
verses.1:52: And the sons of Israel shall camp, each by his own camp and each by his own banner, according to their divisions.
verses.1:53: The Levites, however, shall camp around the tabernacle of the testimony, so that no wrath will be upon the assembly of the sons of Israel; and the Levites shall guard the charge of the tabernacle of the testimony."
verses.1:54: So the sons of Israel did; according to everything the LORD commanded Moses, thus they did.
verses.2:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.2:2: "The sons of Israel shall camp, each man beside his own banner, with the emblems of their fathers' house; they shall camp at a distance, facing the tent of meeting all around.
verses.2:3: Those who camp on the east, toward the rising sun, shall be the banner of the camp of Judah by their forces; the leader of the sons of Judah is Nahshon son of Amminadab,
verses.2:4: and his force, their mustered men, numbers seventy-four thousand six hundred.
verses.2:5: And those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Issachar; the leader of the sons of Issachar is Nethanel son of Zuar,
verses.2:6: and his force, his mustered men, numbers fifty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.2:7: The tribe of Zebulun: the leader of the sons of Zebulun is Eliab son of Helon,
verses.2:8: and his force, his mustered men, numbers fifty-seven thousand four hundred.
verses.2:9: All the mustered men of the camp of Judah number one hundred eighty-six thousand four hundred by their forces. They shall set out first.
verses.2:10: The banner of the camp of Reuben shall be on the south, by their forces; the leader of the sons of Reuben is Elizur son of Shedeur,
verses.2:11: and his force, his mustered men, numbers forty-six thousand five hundred.
verses.2:12: And those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Simeon; the leader of the sons of Simeon is Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai,
verses.2:13: and his force, their mustered men, numbers fifty-nine thousand three hundred.
verses.2:14: And the tribe of Gad: the leader of the sons of Gad is Eliasaph son of Reuel,
verses.2:15: and his force, their mustered men, numbers forty-five thousand six hundred fifty.
verses.2:16: All the mustered men of the camp of Reuben number one hundred fifty-one thousand four hundred fifty by their forces, and they shall set out second.
verses.2:17: Then the tent of meeting, the camp of the Levites, shall set out in the middle of the camps; just as they camp, so they shall set out, each man at his post, by their banners.
verses.2:18: The banner of the camp of Ephraim, by their forces, shall be on the west; the leader of the sons of Ephraim is Elishama son of Ammihud,
verses.2:19: and his force, their mustered men, numbers forty thousand five hundred.
verses.2:20: And next to him shall be the tribe of Manasseh; the leader of the sons of Manasseh is Gamaliel son of Pedahzur,
verses.2:21: and his force, their mustered men, numbers thirty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.2:22: And the tribe of Benjamin: the leader of the sons of Benjamin is Abidan son of Gideoni,
verses.2:23: and his force, their mustered men, numbers thirty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.2:24: All the mustered men of the camp of Ephraim number one hundred eight thousand one hundred by their forces, and they shall set out third.
verses.2:25: The banner of the camp of Dan shall be on the north, by their forces; the leader of the sons of Dan is Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai,
verses.2:26: and his force, their mustered men, numbers sixty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.2:27: And those who camp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher; the leader of the sons of Asher is Pagiel son of Ochran,
verses.2:28: and his force, their mustered men, numbers forty-one thousand five hundred.
verses.2:29: And the tribe of Naphtali: the leader of the sons of Naphtali is Ahira son of Enan,
verses.2:30: and his force, their mustered men, numbers fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.2:31: All the mustered men of the camp of Dan number one hundred fifty-seven thousand six hundred. They shall set out last, by their banners."
verses.2:32: These are the mustered men of the sons of Israel by their fathers' house; all the mustered men of the camps by their forces numbered six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.
verses.2:33: Yet the Levites were not mustered among the sons of Israel, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.2:34: And the sons of Israel did according to everything that the LORD had commanded Moses; so they camped by their banners and so they set out, each man by his clans, with his fathers' house.
verses.3:1: Now these are the generations of Aaron and Moses on the day the LORD spoke with Moses on Mount Sinai.
verses.3:2: And these are the names of the sons of Aaron: the firstborn, Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.3:3: These are the names of the sons of Aaron, the anointed priests, whom he ordained to act as priests.
verses.3:4: But Nadab and Abihu died before the LORD when they presented strange fire before the LORD in the wilderness of Sinai, and they had no sons. So Eleazar and Ithamar acted as priests in the presence of Aaron their father.
verses.3:5: The LORD then spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:6: "Bring near the tribe of Levi and have them stand before Aaron the priest, and they shall minister to him.
verses.3:7: And they shall guard his charge and the charge of the entire congregation before the tent of meeting, to carry out the service of the tabernacle.
verses.3:8: They shall guard all the articles of the tent of meeting and the charge of the sons of Israel, to carry out the service of the tabernacle.
verses.3:9: You shall give the Levites to Aaron and to his sons; they are completely given to him from the sons of Israel.
verses.3:10: But Aaron and his sons you shall appoint, and they shall guard their priesthood; and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death."
verses.3:11: The LORD then spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:12: "Now look, I Myself have taken the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel in place of every firstborn, the opener of the womb from the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall be Mine.
verses.3:13: For every firstborn is Mine; on the day I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated to Myself every firstborn in Israel, from man to animal. Mine they shall be; I am the LORD."
verses.3:14: The LORD then spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, saying,
verses.3:15: "Register the sons of Levi according to their fathers' houses, according to their clans; every male from one month old and upward you shall register."
verses.3:16: So Moses registered them at the word of the LORD, just as he had been commanded.
verses.3:17: Now these were the sons of Levi by their names: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.3:18: And these are the names of the sons of Gershon according to their clans: Libni and Shimei.
verses.3:19: And the sons of Kohath according to their clans: Amram and Izhar, Hebron and Uzziel.
verses.3:20: And the sons of Merari according to their clans: Mahli and Mushi. These are the clans of the Levites according to their fathers' houses.
verses.3:21: Of Gershon: the clan of the Libnites and the clan of the Shimeites; these are the clans of the Gershonites.
verses.3:22: Their registered men, by the number of every male from one month old and upward—their registered men were seven thousand five hundred.
verses.3:23: The clans of the Gershonites were to encamp behind the tabernacle westward.
verses.3:24: And the leader of the father's house for the Gershonites was Eliasaph son of Lael.
verses.3:25: Now the charge of the sons of Gershon in the tent of meeting was the tabernacle and the tent, its covering, and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.3:26: and the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen for the entrance of the courtyard that is around the tabernacle and around the altar, and its cords for all its service.
verses.3:27: And of Kohath: the clan of the Amramites, the clan of the Izharites, the clan of the Hebronites, and the clan of the Uzzielites; these are the clans of the Kohathites.
verses.3:28: By the number of every male from one month old and upward, there were eight thousand six hundred guarding the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.3:29: The clans of the sons of Kohath were to encamp on the side of the tabernacle southward.
verses.3:30: And the leader of the father's house for the clans of the Kohathites was Elizaphan son of Uzziel.
verses.3:31: Their charge was the ark, the table, the lampstand, the altars, and the sanctuary utensils with which they minister, and the screen, and all its service.
verses.3:32: And the leader of the leaders of the Levites was Eleazar son of Aaron the priest, with oversight over those guarding the charge of the sanctuary.
verses.3:33: Of Merari: the clan of the Mahlites and the clan of the Mushites; these are the clans of Merari.
verses.3:34: And their registered men, by the number of every male from one month old and upward, were six thousand two hundred.
verses.3:35: And the leader of the father's house for the clans of Merari was Zuriel son of Abihail; they were to encamp on the side of the tabernacle northward.
verses.3:36: Now the appointed charge of the sons of Merari was the planks of the tabernacle, its crossbars, its pillars, its bases, all its articles, and all its service,
verses.3:37: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, with their bases, their pegs, and their cords.
verses.3:38: And those encamping in front of the tabernacle eastward, before the tent of meeting toward the sunrise, were Moses and Aaron and his sons, guarding the charge of the sanctuary for the charge of the sons of Israel; and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death.
verses.3:39: All the registered men of the Levites whom Moses and Aaron registered at the word of the LORD, according to their clans, every male from one month old and upward, were twenty-two thousand.
verses.3:40: The LORD then said to Moses, "Register every firstborn male of the sons of Israel from one month old and upward, and take the number of their names.
verses.3:41: And you shall take the Levites for Me—I am the LORD—in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of every firstborn among the livestock of the sons of Israel."
verses.3:42: So Moses registered, just as the LORD had commanded him, every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.3:43: And all the firstborn males, by the number of names, from one month old and upward, according to their registered men, came to twenty-two thousand two hundred seventy-three.
verses.3:44: The LORD then spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.3:45: "Take the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel, and the livestock of the Levites in place of their livestock; and the Levites shall be Mine. I am the LORD.
verses.3:46: And as for the redemption of the two hundred seventy-three who exceed the Levites from among the firstborn of the sons of Israel,
verses.3:47: you shall take five shekels each, per head; by the sanctuary shekel you shall take them—the shekel is twenty gerahs.
verses.3:48: And you shall give the silver to Aaron and to his sons, the redemption price of those in excess among them."
verses.3:49: So Moses took the redemption silver from those in excess of those redeemed by the Levites.
verses.3:50: From the firstborn of the sons of Israel he took the silver: one thousand three hundred sixty-five, by the sanctuary shekel.
verses.3:51: And Moses gave the redemption silver to Aaron and to his sons at the word of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.4:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.4:2: "Take a count of the sons of Kohath from among the sons of Levi, by their clans, by their fathers' house,
verses.4:3: from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone who enters active duty to do work in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:4: This is the service of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting: the most sacred things.
verses.4:5: Aaron and his sons shall come in when the camp sets out, and they shall take down the screening veil and cover the ark of the testimony with it.
verses.4:6: Then they shall place on it a covering of fine leather, spread a cloth wholly of blue on top, and set its poles in place.
verses.4:7: Over the table of the Presence they shall spread a blue cloth and place on it the platters, the ladles, the bowls, and the pitchers for the drink offering; and the continual bread shall be on it.
verses.4:8: Then they shall spread over them a scarlet cloth, cover it with a covering of fine leather, and set its poles in place.
verses.4:9: And they shall take a blue cloth and cover the lampstand for the light, its lamps, its tongs, its pans, and all its oil vessels with which they minister to it.
verses.4:10: They shall put it and all its utensils inside a covering of fine leather and set it on the carrying bar.
verses.4:11: Over the gold altar they shall spread a blue cloth, cover it with a covering of fine leather, and set its poles in place.
verses.4:12: And they shall take all the utensils of ministry with which they minister in the sanctuary, put them inside a blue cloth, cover them with a covering of fine leather, and set them on the carrying bar.
verses.4:13: They shall clear the ashes from the altar and spread a purple cloth over it.
verses.4:14: Then they shall place on it all its utensils with which they minister at it—the firepans, the meat forks, the shovels, and the basins, all the utensils of the altar—and spread over it a covering of fine leather, and set its poles in place.
verses.4:15: When Aaron and his sons have finished covering the sacred things and all the furnishings of the sanctuary as the camp sets out, after that the sons of Kohath shall come to carry them; yet they shall not touch the sacred things, or they will die. These are the load of the sons of Kohath in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:16: And the oversight of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, is the oil for the light, the fragrant incense, the continual grain offering, and the anointing oil—the oversight of the whole tabernacle and all that is in it, in the sanctuary and in its furnishings."
verses.4:17: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.4:18: "Do not cause the tribe of the clans of the Kohathites to be cut off from among the Levites;
verses.4:19: rather, do this for them so that they will live and not die when they approach the most sacred things: Aaron and his sons shall come in and assign them, each man to his service and to his load.
verses.4:20: But they shall not go in to look at the sacred things even for an instant, or they will die."
verses.4:21: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:22: "Take a count of the sons of Gershon also, by their fathers' house, by their clans.
verses.4:23: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, you shall register them: everyone who enters to serve on active duty, to perform service in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:24: This is the service of the clans of the Gershonites, in serving and in carrying:
verses.4:25: they shall carry the curtains of the tabernacle, the tent of meeting, its covering, and the covering of fine leather that is on top of it, and the screen for the entrance of the tent of meeting,
verses.4:26: and the hangings of the courtyard, and the screen for the entrance of the gate of the courtyard that is all around the tabernacle and around the altar, and their cords, and all the equipment for their service; and everything that is to be done with them, they shall perform.
verses.4:27: All the service of the sons of the Gershonites—in all their carrying and in all their service—shall be at the command of Aaron and his sons; and you shall assign to them as a charge all their load.
verses.4:28: This is the service of the clans of the sons of the Gershonites in the tent of meeting, and their charge shall be under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest.
verses.4:29: As for the sons of Merari, by their clans, by their fathers' house, you shall register them.
verses.4:30: From thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, you shall register them: everyone who enters active duty to perform the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.4:31: And this is their carrying charge, for all their service in the tent of meeting: the planks of the tabernacle, its crossbars, its pillars, and its bases,
verses.4:32: and the pillars of the courtyard all around, their bases, their pegs, and their cords, along with all their equipment and all their service; and by name you shall assign the items of their carrying charge.
verses.4:33: This is the service of the clans of the sons of Merari, for all their service in the tent of meeting, under the hand of Ithamar, son of Aaron the priest."
verses.4:34: So Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of the congregation registered the sons of the Kohathites by their clans and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:35: from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered active duty for service in the tent of meeting.
verses.4:36: And their registered men by their clans were two thousand seven hundred and fifty.
verses.4:37: These were the registered men of the clans of the Kohathites, everyone who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:38: And the registered men of the sons of Gershon, by their clans and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:39: from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered active duty for service in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:40: their registered men, by their clans, by their fathers' house, were two thousand six hundred and thirty.
verses.4:41: These were the registered men of the clans of the sons of Gershon, everyone who served in the tent of meeting, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the command of the LORD.
verses.4:42: And the registered men of the clans of the sons of Merari, by their clans, by their fathers' house,
verses.4:43: from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered active duty for service in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:44: their registered men by their clans were three thousand two hundred.
verses.4:45: These were the registered men of the clans of the sons of Merari, whom Moses and Aaron registered at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.4:46: All the registered Levites whom Moses, Aaron, and the leaders of Israel registered, by their clans and by their fathers' house,
verses.4:47: from thirty years old and upward, up to fifty years old, everyone who entered to perform the service of labor and the service of carrying in the tent of meeting—
verses.4:48: their registered men were eight thousand five hundred and eighty.
verses.4:49: At the command of the LORD they were registered by the hand of Moses, each man to his service and to his load; and those registered by him were just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.5:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:2: "Command the sons of Israel to send out from the camp every leprous person, and everyone who has a discharge, and everyone unclean through a corpse.
verses.5:3: Both male and female you shall send out; outside the camp you shall send them, so that they do not defile their camps, in the midst of which I dwell."
verses.5:4: And the sons of Israel did so, and they sent them outside the camp; just as the LORD had spoken to Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.5:5: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:6: "Speak to the sons of Israel, 'When a man or a woman commits any of the sins of mankind, committing a breach of faith against the LORD, and that person incurs guilt,
verses.5:7: then they shall confess their sin that they have committed; and he shall repay his restitution in full, add a fifth of it to it, and give it to the one against whom he incurred guilt.
verses.5:8: But if the man has no kinsman-redeemer to whom the restitution can be repaid, the restitution that is repaid belongs to the LORD, for the priest, besides the ram of atonement by which he makes atonement for him.
verses.5:9: Also every contribution from all the holy gifts of the sons of Israel that they present to the priest shall be his.
verses.5:10: And each man's holy gifts shall be his own; whatever a man gives to the priest shall belong to him.'"
verses.5:11: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:12: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'If the wife of any man turns aside and commits a breach of faith against him,
verses.5:13: and a man lies with her in sexual union, and it is hidden from the eyes of her husband, and she remains concealed though she has become defiled, and there is no witness against her, and she was not caught,
verses.5:14: and a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he becomes jealous of his wife when she has become defiled, or a spirit of jealousy passes over him and he becomes jealous of his wife when she has not become defiled,
verses.5:15: then the man shall bring his wife to the priest and shall bring her offering on her behalf, a tenth of an ephah of barley flour; he shall not pour oil on it nor put frankincense on it, for it is a grain offering of jealousy, a grain offering of remembrance, calling iniquity to remembrance.
verses.5:16: Then the priest shall bring her near and station her before the LORD.
verses.5:17: And the priest shall take holy water in a clay vessel, and the priest shall take some of the dust that is on the floor of the tabernacle and put it into the water.
verses.5:18: Then the priest shall station the woman before the LORD, loosen the hair of the woman's head, and place on her palms the grain offering of remembrance—it is a grain offering of jealousy—while in the priest's hand shall be the water of bitterness that inflicts a curse.
verses.5:19: And the priest shall put her under oath and say to the woman, "If no man has lain with you, and if you have not turned aside to uncleanness while under your husband's authority, be free from this water of bitterness that inflicts a curse.
verses.5:20: But if you have turned aside while under your husband's authority, and if you have become defiled, and a man besides your husband has lain with you—"
verses.5:21: then the priest shall put the woman under the oath of the curse, and the priest shall say to the woman, "May the LORD make you a curse and an oath in the midst of your people, when the LORD causes your thigh to fall away and your belly to swell;
verses.5:22: and may this water that inflicts a curse enter your inward parts to make the belly swell and to make the thigh fall away." And the woman shall say, "Amen, amen."

verses.5:28: But if the woman has not become defiled and she is clean, then she shall be acquitted and shall conceive offspring.

verses.6:1: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'When a man or a woman makes an extraordinary vow, the vow of a Nazirite, to dedicate himself to the LORD,
verses.6:3: he shall abstain from wine and strong drink; he shall drink no vinegar of wine or vinegar of strong drink, nor shall he drink any liquid steeped from grapes, nor eat grapes, fresh or dried.
verses.6:4: All the days of his dedication he shall not eat anything produced from the grapevine, from the seeds even to the skin.
verses.6:5: All the days of the vow of his dedication no razor shall pass over his head; until the days are fulfilled for which he dedicates himself to the LORD, he shall be holy, letting the locks of the hair of his head grow long.
verses.6:6: All the days of his dedication to the LORD he shall not go near a dead body.
verses.6:7: For his father or for his mother, for his brother or for his sister, he shall not defile himself for them when they die, because his dedication to his God is on his head.
verses.6:8: All the days of his dedication he is holy to the LORD.
verses.6:9: And if someone dies beside him very suddenly and defiles his dedicated head, then he shall shave his head on the day of his cleansing; on the seventh day he shall shave it.
verses.6:10: Then on the eighth day he shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest, to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:11: And the priest shall offer one as a sin offering and one as a burnt offering, and make atonement for him for what he sinned concerning the dead body, and he shall consecrate his head on that day.
verses.6:12: And he shall dedicate to the LORD the days of his dedication and bring a male lamb a year old as a guilt offering; but the former days shall lapse, because his dedication became defiled.
verses.6:13: Now this is the law of the Nazirite: on the day the days of his dedication are fulfilled, he shall be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.6:14: And he shall present his offering to the LORD: one unblemished male lamb a year old as a burnt offering, one unblemished ewe lamb a year old as a sin offering, and one unblemished ram as peace offerings,
verses.6:15: and a basket of unleavened bread, loaves of fine flour mixed with oil and unleavened wafers spread with oil, together with their grain offering and their drink offerings.
verses.6:16: Then the priest shall present them before the LORD and offer his sin offering and his burnt offering.
verses.6:17: And he shall offer the ram as a sacrifice of peace offerings to the LORD, together with the basket of unleavened bread; and the priest shall also offer its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.6:18: Then the Nazirite shall shave his dedicated head at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and he shall take the hair of his dedicated head and put it on the fire that is under the sacrifice of the peace offerings.
verses.6:19: And the priest shall take the boiled shoulder from the ram, and one unleavened loaf from the basket, and one unleavened wafer, and place them on the palms of the Nazirite after he has shaved off his dedicated hair.
verses.6:20: Then the priest shall wave them as a wave offering before the LORD; it is a holy portion for the priest, together with the breast of the wave offering and the thigh of the contribution. And afterward the Nazirite may drink wine.
verses.6:21: This is the law of the Nazirite who makes a vow, and of his offering to the LORD for his dedication, apart from whatever else he can afford; according to the vow that he makes, so he shall do, in addition to the law of his dedication.'"
verses.6:22: Now the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:23: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'In this way you shall bless the sons of Israel, saying to them'—so they shall place My name on the sons of Israel, and I will bless them:
verses.6:24: 'May the LORD bless you and guard you;
verses.6:25: may the LORD cause His face to shine toward you and be gracious to you;
verses.6:26: may the LORD lift up His face toward you and establish peace for you.'"

verses.8:1: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Speak to Aaron and tell him, 'When you set up the lamps, the seven lamps shall shed light toward the front of the lampstand.'"
verses.8:3: And Aaron did thus: he set up its lamps toward the front of the lampstand, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.8:4: Now this was the construction of the lampstand: hammered gold; from its base to its blossom, it was hammered work. According to the form that the LORD had shown Moses, so he made the lampstand.
verses.8:5: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:6: "Take the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel and purify them.
verses.8:7: And thus you shall do to them to purify them: sprinkle water for purification upon them, and they shall pass a razor over all their flesh, wash their garments, and purify themselves.
verses.8:8: Then they shall take a young bull of the herd and its grain offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and you shall take a second young bull of the herd for a sin offering.
verses.8:9: You shall bring the Levites near before the tent of meeting, and you shall assemble the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.8:10: Then you shall bring the Levites near before the LORD, and the sons of Israel shall lay their hands upon the Levites.
verses.8:11: And Aaron shall wave the Levites as a wave offering before the LORD from the sons of Israel, so that they may perform the service of the LORD.
verses.8:12: And the Levites shall lay their hands upon the heads of the bulls, then you shall offer the one as a sin offering and the other as a burnt offering to the LORD, to atone for the Levites.
verses.8:13: You shall station the Levites before Aaron and before his sons, and wave them as a wave offering to the LORD.
verses.8:14: Thus you shall set the Levites apart from the midst of the sons of Israel, and the Levites shall belong to Me.
verses.8:15: Afterward the Levites shall enter to serve the tent of meeting; you shall purify them and wave them as a wave offering.
verses.8:16: For they are completely given to Me from the midst of the sons of Israel. In place of what opens every womb, the firstborn of all among the sons of Israel, I have taken them for Myself.
verses.8:17: For every firstborn among the sons of Israel belongs to Me, both human and animal; on the day I struck every firstborn in the land of Egypt, I consecrated them to Myself.
verses.8:18: So I have taken the Levites in place of every firstborn among the sons of Israel.
verses.8:19: And I have given the Levites as gifts to Aaron and to his sons from the midst of the sons of Israel, to perform the service of the sons of Israel in the tent of meeting and to atone for the sons of Israel, so that there will be no plague among the sons of Israel when the sons of Israel approach the sanctuary."
verses.8:20: And Moses, Aaron, and the entire congregation of the sons of Israel did to the Levites in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded Moses regarding the Levites; so the sons of Israel did to them.
verses.8:21: And the Levites cleansed themselves from sin and washed their garments, and Aaron waved them as a wave offering before the LORD, and Aaron atoned for them to purify them.
verses.8:22: Afterward the Levites entered to perform their service in the tent of meeting before Aaron and before his sons; as the LORD had commanded Moses regarding the Levites, thus they did for them.
verses.8:23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:24: "This is what applies to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward, each shall enter to serve a term of duty in the service of the tent of meeting,
verses.8:25: but from fifty years old he shall withdraw from the duty of the service and shall serve no longer.
verses.8:26: He may minister to his brothers in the tent of meeting to keep the charge, yet he shall perform no service. In this way you shall do for the Levites regarding their charges."
verses.9:1: The LORD spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai, in the second year after their departure from the land of Egypt, in the first month, saying,
verses.9:2: "Let the sons of Israel observe the Passover at its set time.
verses.9:3: On the fourteenth day of this month, at twilight, you shall observe it at its set time; in accordance with all its statutes and in accordance with all its regulations you shall observe it."
verses.9:4: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel that they should observe the Passover.
verses.9:5: And they observed the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at twilight, in the wilderness of Sinai; in accordance with everything that the LORD had commanded Moses, so the sons of Israel did.
verses.9:6: Now there were certain men who were impure because of a human corpse, and they could not observe the Passover on that day; so they drew near before Moses and before Aaron on that day.
verses.9:7: And those men said to him, "We are impure because of a human corpse. Why should we be held back from presenting the offering of the LORD at its set time in the midst of the sons of Israel?"
verses.9:8: And Moses said to them, "Stand still, and let me hear what the LORD will command concerning you."
verses.9:9: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.9:10: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'If any man of you or of your generations is impure because of a corpse, or is on a distant journey, he shall observe Passover to the LORD.
verses.9:11: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at twilight, they shall observe it; with unleavened bread and bitter herbs they shall eat it.
verses.9:12: They shall not leave any of it until morning, and they shall break no bone of it; in accordance with the entire statute of the Passover they shall observe it.
verses.9:13: But the man who is pure and was not on a journey, yet refrains from observing the Passover—that person shall be cut off from his people; because he did not present the offering of the LORD at its set time, that man shall bear his sin.
verses.9:14: And if a resident alien resides with you and observes Passover to the LORD, in accordance with the statute of the Passover and in accordance with its regulation, so he shall do. There shall be one statute for you, both for the resident alien and for the native of the land.'"
verses.9:15: On the day the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, the tent of the testimony; and in the evening it would be above the tabernacle like the appearance of fire until morning.
verses.9:16: Thus it would be continually: the cloud would cover it, and the appearance of fire by night.
verses.9:17: And whenever the cloud was lifted up from above the tent, afterward the sons of Israel would set out; and at the place where the cloud rested, there the sons of Israel would encamp.
verses.9:18: At the command of the LORD the sons of Israel would set out, and at the command of the LORD they would encamp; all the days that the cloud rested above the tabernacle, they would stay encamped.
verses.9:19: And when the cloud lingered above the tabernacle many days, the sons of Israel would keep the charge of the LORD and would not set out.
verses.9:20: At times the cloud would be above the tabernacle for a few days; at the command of the LORD they would encamp, and at the command of the LORD they would set out.
verses.9:21: And at times the cloud would be there from evening until morning, and when the cloud was lifted up in the morning, they would set out; or for a day and a night, when the cloud was lifted up, they would set out.
verses.9:22: Whether two days, or a month, or a longer period, while the cloud lingered above the tabernacle, resting upon it, the sons of Israel would stay encamped and would not set out; but when it was lifted up, they would set out.
verses.9:23: At the command of the LORD they would encamp, and at the command of the LORD they would set out; they kept the charge of the LORD, at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.10:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.10:2: "Make for yourself two trumpets of silver; you shall make them of hammered work, and they shall serve you for summoning the congregation and for moving out the camps.
verses.10:3: When they blow them, the whole congregation shall gather to you at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.10:4: But if they blow one, then the leaders, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather to you.
verses.10:5: When you blow an alarm, the camps encamped on the east side shall set out.
verses.10:6: When you blow an alarm a second time, the camps encamped on the south side shall set out; they shall blow an alarm for their departures.
verses.10:7: When convening the assembly, however, you shall blow, and you shall not sound an alarm.
verses.10:8: The sons of Aaron, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be for you a perpetual statute throughout your generations.
verses.10:9: And when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets, and you will be remembered before the LORD your God and saved from your enemies.
verses.10:10: And on your day of rejoicing, at your set festivals, and at the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings, and they shall serve you as a memorial before your God. I am the LORD your God."
verses.10:11: Now in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth of the month, the cloud was lifted from above the tabernacle of the testimony.
verses.10:12: So the sons of Israel set out by their stages from the wilderness of Sinai, and the cloud settled in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.10:13: They set out for the first time at the command of the LORD by the hand of Moses.
verses.10:14: The banner of the camp of the sons of Judah set out first by their forces, and over its force was Nahshon son of Amminadab.
verses.10:15: Over the force of the tribe of the sons of Issachar was Nethanel son of Zuar.
verses.10:16: And over the force of the tribe of the sons of Zebulun was Eliab son of Helon.
verses.10:17: Then the tabernacle was taken down, and the sons of Gershon and the sons of Merari set out, carrying the tabernacle.
verses.10:18: Next the banner of the camp of Reuben set out by their forces, and over its force was Elizur son of Shedeur.
verses.10:19: Over the force of the tribe of the sons of Simeon was Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai.
verses.10:20: And over the force of the tribe of the sons of Gad was Eliasaph son of Deuel.
verses.10:21: Then the Kohathites set out, carrying the sanctuary, and the tabernacle was set up by the time they arrived.
verses.10:22: Next the banner of the camp of the sons of Ephraim set out by their forces, and over its force was Elishama son of Ammihud.
verses.10:23: Over the force of the tribe of the sons of Manasseh was Gamaliel son of Pedahzur.
verses.10:24: And over the force of the tribe of the sons of Benjamin was Abidan son of Gideoni.
verses.10:25: Then the banner of the camp of the sons of Dan, the rear guard for all the camps, set out by their forces, and over its force was Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai.
verses.10:26: Over the force of the tribe of the sons of Asher was Pagiel son of Ochran.
verses.10:27: And over the force of the tribe of the sons of Naphtali was Ahira son of Enan.
verses.10:28: This was the order of departure of the sons of Israel by their forces, and they set out.
verses.10:29: Then Moses said to Hobab son of Reuel the Midianite, Moses' father-in-law, "We are setting out for the place of which the LORD said, 'I will give it to you.' Come with us and we will do good to you, for the LORD has spoken good concerning Israel."
verses.10:30: But he said to him, "I will not go; instead, I will go to my own land and to my relatives."
verses.10:31: Then he said, "Please do not leave us, because you know where we should camp in the wilderness, and you will serve as eyes for us.
verses.10:32: And if you go with us, whatever good the LORD does for us, we will do that same good to you."
verses.10:33: So they set out from the mountain of the LORD on a three-day journey, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD traveled ahead of them for a three-day journey to scout out a resting place for them.
verses.10:34: Now whenever the ark set out, Moses would say, "Rise up, LORD, and may Your enemies scatter, and may those who hate You flee from Your presence."
verses.10:35: And when it came to rest, he would say, "Return, LORD, to the ten thousands of the thousands of Israel."
verses.10:36: And the cloud of the LORD was above them by day when they set out from the camp.
verses.11:1: Now the people were acting like complainers of hardship in the ears of the LORD; and the LORD heard, and His anger flared, and the fire of the LORD burned among them and consumed part of the edge of the camp.
verses.11:2: Then the people cried out to Moses, and Moses prayed to the LORD, and the fire subsided.
verses.11:3: So he called the name of that place Taberah, because the fire of the LORD had burned among them.
verses.11:4: Now the rabble who were among them felt a fierce craving, and the sons of Israel also wept again and said, "Who will feed us meat?
verses.11:5: We remember the fish that we used to eat in Egypt for nothing, the cucumbers, the melons, the leeks, the onions, and the garlic.
verses.11:6: But now our appetite has dried up; there is nothing at all, only the manna before our eyes."
verses.11:7: Now the manna was like coriander seed, and its appearance was like the appearance of bdellium.
verses.11:8: The people would go about and gather it, and grind it between millstones or pound it in a mortar, and boil it in a pot and make it into cakes; and its taste was like the taste of rich oil.
verses.11:9: When the dew came down upon the camp at night, the manna would come down upon it.
verses.11:10: Then Moses heard the people weeping throughout their families, each man at the entrance of his tent; and the anger of the LORD flared greatly, and it was evil in the eyes of Moses.
verses.11:11: So Moses said to the LORD, "Why have You treated Your servant badly? And why have I not found favor in Your eyes, that You have laid the burden of all this people upon me?
verses.11:12: Was it I who conceived all this people? Or was it I who gave birth to them, that You say to me, 'Carry them in your bosom, as a nurse carries a nursing infant,' to the land that You swore to their fathers?
verses.11:13: Where am I to get meat to give to all this people? For they keep weeping before me, saying, 'Give us meat that we may eat.'
verses.11:14: I alone am not able to carry all this people, because it is too heavy for me.
verses.11:15: If this is how You are going to treat me, please kill me outright, if I have found favor in Your eyes, and do not let me look upon my own wretchedness."
verses.11:16: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Gather for Me seventy men from the elders of Israel, whom you know to be elders of the people and their officials, and take them to the tent of meeting, and let them take their stand there with you.
verses.11:17: And I will come down and speak with you there, and I will withdraw some of the Spirit that is upon you and place it upon them; and they shall carry the burden of the people with you, so that you will not carry it by yourself.
verses.11:18: And to the people you shall say, 'Consecrate yourselves for tomorrow, and you shall eat meat, for you have wept in the ears of the LORD, saying, "Who will feed us meat? For it was good for us in Egypt." So the LORD will give you meat, and you shall eat.
verses.11:19: You shall not eat for one day, nor two days, nor five days, nor ten days, nor twenty days,
verses.11:20: but for a full month, until it comes out through your nostrils and becomes repulsive to you, because you have rejected the LORD who is in your midst and have wept before Him, saying, "Why did we ever come out of Egypt?"'"
verses.11:21: But Moses said, "The people in whose midst I am are six hundred thousand on foot, and yet You have said, 'I will give them meat, and they shall eat for a full month.'
verses.11:22: Shall flocks and herds be slaughtered for them and be enough for them? Or shall all the fish of the sea be gathered for them and be enough for them?"
verses.11:23: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Is the hand of the LORD too short? Now you will see whether My word comes to pass for you or not."
verses.11:24: So Moses went out and spoke the words of the LORD to the people; and he gathered seventy men from the elders of the people and stationed them around the tent.
verses.11:25: Then the LORD came down in the cloud and spoke to him, and withdrew some of the Spirit that was upon him and put it upon the seventy elders. And when the Spirit rested upon them, they prophesied, but they did not do so again.
verses.11:26: Now two men had remained in the camp; the name of the one was Eldad, and the name of the second was Medad. And the Spirit rested upon them—they were among those registered, though they had not gone out to the tent—and they prophesied in the camp.
verses.11:27: So a young man ran and reported to Moses and said, "Eldad and Medad are prophesying in the camp."
verses.11:28: Then Joshua son of Nun, Moses' attendant from his youth, spoke up and said, "My lord Moses, restrain them!"
verses.11:29: But Moses said to him, "Are you jealous on my behalf? If only all the people of the LORD were prophets, that the LORD would place His Spirit upon them!"
verses.11:30: Then Moses withdrew to the camp, he and the elders of Israel.
verses.11:31: Now a wind went out from the LORD, and it swept quail in from the sea and dropped them beside the camp, about a day's journey on this side and about a day's journey on that side, all around the camp, and about two cubits above the surface of the ground.
verses.11:32: And the people were up all that day and all the night and all the next day, and they gathered the quail; the one who gathered least gathered ten homers. And they spread them out widely for themselves all around the camp.
verses.11:33: While the meat was still between their teeth, before it was chewed, the anger of the LORD flared against the people, and the LORD struck the people with a very severe plague.
verses.11:34: So the name of that place was called Kibroth-hattaavah, because there they buried the people who had been craving.
verses.11:35: From Kibroth-hattaavah the people set out for Hazeroth, and they remained at Hazeroth.
verses.12:1: And Miriam and Aaron spoke against Moses on account of the Cushite woman he had taken, because he had taken a Cushite woman.
verses.12:2: They said, "Has the LORD spoken solely through Moses alone? Has He not spoken through us as well?" And the LORD heard.
verses.12:3: Now the man Moses was exceedingly humble, more than all humanity on the face of the ground.
verses.12:4: All at once the LORD said to Moses, to Aaron, and to Miriam, "Go out, the three of you, to the tent of meeting." And the three of them went out.
verses.12:5: Then the LORD descended in a column of cloud and stood at the entrance of the tent; He summoned Aaron and Miriam, and both of them stepped out.
verses.12:6: He said, "Listen now to My words: If there is a prophet of yours, I, the LORD, make Myself known to him in a vision; in a dream I speak with him.
verses.12:7: My servant Moses is not like that; in all My house he is trustworthy.
verses.12:8: Mouth to mouth I speak with him, in plain sight and not in riddles, and he gazes at the form of the LORD. Why then did you not fear to speak against My servant, against Moses?"
verses.12:9: The LORD's anger flared against them, and He went away.
verses.12:10: And the cloud moved away from above the tent, and look, Miriam was leprous, like snow. Aaron turned to Miriam, and look, she was leprous.
verses.12:11: Aaron said to Moses, "Please, my lord, do not lay sin on us, because we have acted foolishly and because we have sinned.
verses.12:12: Please do not let her be like someone dead, who, when coming out from his mother's womb, has half his flesh consumed."
verses.12:13: Then Moses cried out to the LORD, saying, "God, please, heal her, please!"
verses.12:14: And the LORD said to Moses, "If her father had truly spat in her face, would she not be disgraced for seven days? Let her be confined outside the camp for seven days, and afterward she may be gathered back in."
verses.12:15: So Miriam was confined outside the camp for seven days, and the people did not journey on until Miriam was gathered back in.
verses.12:16: Afterward the people journeyed from Hazeroth and encamped in the wilderness of Paran.
verses.13:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.13:2: "Send men for yourself to scout out the land of Canaan, which I am giving to the sons of Israel; you shall send one man each for the tribe of his fathers, every one a chieftain among them."
verses.13:3: Moses sent them out from the wilderness of Paran by the word of the LORD; they were all men, heads of the sons of Israel.
verses.13:4: These are their names. For the tribe of Reuben: Shammua, son of Zaccur.
verses.13:5: For the tribe of Simeon: Shaphat, son of Hori.
verses.13:6: For the tribe of Judah: Caleb, son of Jephunneh.
verses.13:7: For the tribe of Issachar: Igal, son of Joseph.
verses.13:8: For the tribe of Ephraim: Hoshea, son of Nun.
verses.13:9: For the tribe of Benjamin: Palti, son of Raphu.
verses.13:10: For the tribe of Zebulun: Gaddiel, son of Sodi.
verses.13:11: For the tribe of Joseph, for the tribe of Manasseh: Gaddi, son of Susi.
verses.13:12: For the tribe of Dan: Ammiel, son of Gemalli.
verses.13:13: For the tribe of Asher: Sethur, son of Michael.
verses.13:14: For the tribe of Naphtali: Nahbi, son of Vophsi.
verses.13:15: For the tribe of Gad: Geuel, son of Machi.
verses.13:16: These are the names of the men Moses sent to scout out the land, and Moses named Hoshea, son of Nun, Joshua.
verses.13:17: Moses sent them to scout out the land of Canaan, and he said to them, "Go up this way into the Negev, and go up into the hill country.
verses.13:18: See the land, what it is like, and the people dwelling on it: are they strong or weak? Are they few or numerous?
verses.13:19: And what is the land where they dwell like—is it good or bad? And what are the cities where they dwell like—are they in camps or in fortresses?
verses.13:20: And what is the land like—is it rich or lean? Are there trees in it or none? Strengthen yourselves and take some of the land's fruit." Now those days were the days of the first-ripening grapes.
verses.13:21: So they went up and scouted out the land, from the wilderness of Zin as far as Rehob, at the entrance to Hamath.
verses.13:22: They went up into the Negev, and he came as far as Hebron; Ahiman, Sheshai, and Talmai, the offspring of Anak, were there. Now Hebron had been built seven years before Zoan of Egypt.
verses.13:23: Then they came as far as the Valley of Eshcol, and from there they cut off a vine branch and one cluster of grapes; two of them carried it on a pole, along with some of the pomegranates and some of the figs.
verses.13:24: That place was named the Valley of Eshcol on account of the cluster the sons of Israel had cut off from there.
verses.13:25: They returned from scouting out the land at the close of forty days.
verses.13:26: They went and came to Moses, to Aaron, and to the entire assembly of the sons of Israel, to the wilderness of Paran, at Kadesh. They brought word back to them and to the entire assembly, and showed them the fruit of the land.
verses.13:27: They reported to him and said, "We came into the land where you sent us; it truly flows with milk and honey, and here is its fruit.
verses.13:28: Yet the people dwelling in the land are mighty, and the cities are fortified and exceedingly large; furthermore, we saw the offspring of Anak there.
verses.13:29: Amalek dwells in the land of the Negev; the Hittites, the Jebusites, and the Amorites dwell in the hill country; and the Canaanites dwell beside the sea and alongside the Jordan."
verses.13:30: Then Caleb hushed the people before Moses and said, "Let us surely go up and take possession of it, for we can indeed prevail over it."
verses.13:31: Yet the men who had gone up alongside him said, "We cannot go up against the people, because they are stronger than we are."
verses.13:32: They put out a slanderous report to the sons of Israel concerning the land they had scouted out, saying, "The land through which we passed to scout it out is a land that consumes its inhabitants, and all the people we saw in its midst are men of great stature.
verses.13:33: And there we saw the Nephilim—the sons of Anak are from the Nephilim—and in our own eyes we were like grasshoppers, and so we were in their eyes."
verses.14:1: So the whole congregation raised their voice and cried out, and the people wept that night.
verses.14:2: All the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and against Aaron, and the whole congregation said to them, "If only we had died in the land of Egypt! Or if only we had died in this wilderness!
verses.14:3: And why is the LORD bringing us to this land to fall by the sword? Our wives and our little ones will be plunder. Is it not better for us to return to Egypt?"
verses.14:4: And they said to each other, "Let us appoint a leader, and let us return to Egypt."
verses.14:5: And Moses and Aaron fell on their faces before the whole assembly of the congregation of the sons of Israel.
verses.14:6: And Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh, from among those who had explored the land, tore their garments.
verses.14:7: And they spoke to the whole congregation of the sons of Israel, saying, "The land through which we passed to explore it, the land is very, very good.
verses.14:8: If the LORD takes pleasure in us, then He will bring us to this land and give it to us, a land that is flowing with milk and honey.
verses.14:9: Only do not rebel against the LORD; and as for you, do not be afraid of the people of the land, for they are our bread. Their shade has departed from over them, and the LORD is with us; do not be afraid of them."
verses.14:10: And the whole congregation spoke of stoning them with stones, but the glory of the LORD appeared at the tent of meeting to all the sons of Israel.
verses.14:11: And the LORD said to Moses, "How long will this people scorn Me? And how long will they not trust in Me, in spite of all the signs that I have done in their midst?
verses.14:12: I will strike them with pestilence and disinherit them, and I will make you into a nation greater and stronger than they."
verses.14:13: But Moses said to the LORD, "Then the Egyptians will hear, for You brought this people up from their midst by Your power,
verses.14:14: and they will tell the inhabitants of this land. They have heard that You, LORD, are in the midst of this people—for You, LORD, appear eye to eye, and Your cloud stands over them, and in a pillar of cloud You go before them by day and in a pillar of fire by night.
verses.14:15: Now if You put this people to death as one man, then the nations that have heard the report of You will say,
verses.14:16: 'Because the LORD was unable to bring this people into the land that He swore to them, He slaughtered them in the wilderness.'
verses.14:17: And now, please, let the power of the Lord be great, just as You spoke, saying,
verses.14:18: 'The LORD is slow to anger and abundant in faithful love, pardoning iniquity and transgression, yet He will certainly not acquit the guilty, bringing the iniquity of fathers to account upon children, upon the third and upon the fourth generations.'
verses.14:19: Please forgive the iniquity of this people according to the greatness of Your faithful love, and just as You have pardoned this people from Egypt until now."
verses.14:20: And the LORD said, "I have forgiven, in accordance with your word.
verses.14:21: Nevertheless, as I live, and as the entire earth will be filled with the glory of the LORD,
verses.14:22: all the men who saw My glory and My signs that I did in Egypt and in the wilderness, yet tested Me these ten times and did not listen to My voice—
verses.14:23: not one of them will see the land that I swore to their fathers, and none of those who scorn Me will see it.
verses.14:24: But as for My servant Caleb, because a different spirit has been with him and he has followed Me wholeheartedly, I will bring him into the land where he went, and his offspring will take possession of it.
verses.14:25: Now the Amalekites and the Canaanites are living in the valley. Tomorrow turn around and set out into the wilderness by the way to the Sea of Reeds."
verses.14:26: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.14:27: "How long must I bear with this evil congregation who are grumbling against Me? I have heard the grumblings of the sons of Israel that they are grumbling against Me.
verses.14:28: Tell them, 'As I live, declares the LORD, surely just as you have spoken in My ears, so will I do to you:
verses.14:29: In this wilderness your corpses will fall, even all of you who were registered, according to your full count, from twenty years old and upward, who have grumbled against Me.
verses.14:30: You will certainly not come into the land I lifted up My hand to settle you in, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.14:31: But as for your little ones, who you said would be plunder, I will bring them in, and they will come to know the land that you rejected.
verses.14:32: Yet your own corpses will fall in this wilderness.
verses.14:33: And your children will be shepherds in the wilderness for forty years, and they will bear your acts of prostitution until your corpses come to an end in the wilderness.
verses.14:34: By the number of the days in which you explored the land, forty days—for each day a year—you will bear your iniquities for forty years, and you will know My hostility.
verses.14:35: I, the LORD, have spoken. Surely I will do this to this whole evil congregation who have assembled against Me: in this wilderness they will come to an end, and there they will die.'"
verses.14:36: Now the men whom Moses sent to explore the land, who returned and caused the whole congregation to grumble against him by spreading a bad report against the land—
verses.14:37: those men who spread an evil report about the land died by a plague before the LORD.
verses.14:38: But Joshua son of Nun and Caleb son of Jephunneh stayed alive from among those men who went to explore the land.
verses.14:39: And Moses spoke these words to all the sons of Israel, and the people mourned deeply.
verses.14:40: They rose early in the morning and went up to the crest of the hill country, saying, "Here we are, and we will go up to the place about which the LORD spoke, for we have sinned."
verses.14:41: But Moses said, "Why then are you violating the command of the LORD? And it will not succeed!
verses.14:42: Do not go up, for the LORD is not in your midst, so that you will not be defeated before your enemies.
verses.14:43: For the Amalekites and the Canaanites are there in front of you, and you will fall by the sword; since you have turned back from following the LORD, the LORD will not be with you."
verses.14:44: Yet they presumed to go up to the crest of the hill country, while the ark of the covenant of the LORD and Moses did not move from the midst of the camp.
verses.14:45: Then the Amalekites and the Canaanites who lived in that hill country came down, and they struck them and crushed them as far as Hormah.
verses.15:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'When you come into the land of your dwelling places, which I am giving to you,
verses.15:3: and you prepare a fire offering to the LORD, a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a solemn vow or as a voluntary offering or at your appointed festivals, to produce a soothing fragrance to the LORD from the herd or from the flock,
verses.15:4: then the one presenting his offering to the LORD shall present a grain offering of a tenth of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a quarter of a hin of oil.
verses.15:5: And you shall prepare a quarter of a hin of wine for the drink offering, with the burnt offering or for the sacrifice, for each lamb.
verses.15:6: Or for a ram you shall prepare a grain offering of two-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with a third of a hin of oil,
verses.15:7: and for the drink offering you shall present a third of a hin of wine as a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.15:8: And when you prepare a bull from the herd as a burnt offering or a sacrifice, to fulfill a solemn vow or as peace offerings to the LORD,
verses.15:9: then one shall present with the bull from the herd a grain offering of three-tenths of an ephah of fine flour mixed with half a hin of oil;
verses.15:10: and you shall present half a hin of wine for the drink offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.15:11: In this way it shall be done for each ox, or for each ram, or for an animal among the sheep or among the goats.
verses.15:12: In accordance with the number you prepare, in this way you shall do for each one in accordance with their number.
verses.15:13: Every native shall do these things in this way in presenting a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.15:14: And if a sojourner resides with you, or anyone who is in your midst throughout your generations, and prepares a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD, just as you do, so he shall do.
verses.15:15: As for the assembly, there shall be one statute for you and for the residing sojourner, a perpetual statute throughout your generations; as you are, so shall the sojourner be before the LORD.
verses.15:16: There shall be one law and one ordinance for you and for the sojourner who resides with you.'"
verses.15:17: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.15:18: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them, 'When you enter the land into which I am bringing you,
verses.15:19: then it shall be that when you eat from the bread of the land, you shall lift up a contribution to the LORD.
verses.15:20: As the first of your dough you shall lift up a loaf as a contribution; like the contribution of a threshing floor, so you shall lift it up.
verses.15:21: From the first of your dough you shall give a contribution to the LORD throughout your generations.
verses.15:22: And when you err and do not carry out all these commandments that the LORD has spoken to Moses,
verses.15:23: all that the LORD has commanded you by the hand of Moses, from the day the LORD gave command and onward throughout your generations,
verses.15:24: then it shall be that if it is done inadvertently, out of the sight of the congregation, the whole congregation shall prepare one bull from the herd for a burnt offering, for a soothing fragrance to the LORD, with its grain offering and its drink offering according to the ordinance, and one male goat for a sin offering.
verses.15:25: And the priest shall make atonement for all the congregation of the sons of Israel, and they shall be forgiven, because it was an inadvertent error, and they have brought their offering, a fire offering to the LORD, and their sin offering before the LORD for their inadvertent error.
verses.15:26: So all the congregation of the sons of Israel and the sojourner who resides in their midst shall be forgiven, because for all the people it happened inadvertently.
verses.15:27: And if one person sins inadvertently, then that person shall present a year-old female goat for a sin offering.
verses.15:28: And the priest shall make atonement for the person who errs, when he sins inadvertently, before the LORD, to make atonement for him, and he shall be forgiven.
verses.15:29: For the native among the sons of Israel and for the sojourner who resides in their midst, there shall be one law for you, for the one who acts inadvertently.
verses.15:30: But the person who acts with a high hand, whether native or sojourner, that one blasphemes the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from the midst of his people.
verses.15:31: Because he has despised the word of the LORD and violated His commandment, that person shall certainly be cut off; his guilt is upon him.'"
verses.15:32: Now the sons of Israel were in the wilderness, and they found a man gathering sticks on the Sabbath day.
verses.15:33: And those who found him gathering sticks brought him forward to Moses and to Aaron and to the whole congregation.
verses.15:34: And they placed him in custody, because it had not been specified what should be done to him.
verses.15:35: Then the LORD said to Moses, "The man shall certainly be put to death; the whole congregation shall stone him with stones outside the camp."
verses.15:36: So the whole congregation brought him outside the camp and stoned him with stones, and he died, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.15:37: Then the LORD said to Moses,
verses.15:38: "Speak to the sons of Israel and say to them that they shall make tassels for themselves on the corners of their garments throughout their generations, and they shall put a cord of blue on the tassel of each corner.
verses.15:39: It shall be a tassel for you, and you shall look at it and remember all the commandments of the LORD and carry them out, and you shall not go roving after your heart and after your eyes, after which you prostitute yourselves,
verses.15:40: so that you may remember and carry out all My commandments and be holy to your God.
verses.15:41: I am the LORD your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt to be God to you; I am the LORD your God."
verses.16:1: Now Korah, son of Izhar, son of Kohath, son of Levi, took with him Dathan and Abiram, sons of Eliab, and On, son of Peleth, sons of Reuben,
verses.16:2: and they rose up before Moses, together with two hundred fifty men from the sons of Israel, leaders of the congregation, those summoned to the assembly, men of renown.
verses.16:3: They assembled against Moses and against Aaron and said to them, "Enough from you! For the entire congregation, all of them, are holy, and the LORD is in their midst. Why then do you exalt yourselves above the assembly of the LORD?"
verses.16:4: Moses heard, and he fell on his face.
verses.16:5: And he spoke to Korah and to all his company, saying, "In the morning the LORD will make known who belongs to Him and who is holy, and He will bring him near to Himself; the one whom He chooses, He will bring near to Himself.
verses.16:6: Do this: take firepans for yourselves, Korah and all his company,
verses.16:7: and put fire in them and place incense on them before the LORD tomorrow. Then the man whom the LORD chooses, he is the holy one. Enough from you, sons of Levi!"
verses.16:8: Then Moses said to Korah, "Listen now, sons of Levi:
verses.16:9: Is it a small matter to you that the God of Israel has set you apart from the congregation of Israel, to bring you near to Himself, to carry out the service of the tabernacle of the LORD, and to stand before the congregation to minister to them?
verses.16:10: And He has brought you near, and all your brothers, the sons of Levi, with you; and are you seeking the priesthood as well?
verses.16:11: Therefore it is against the LORD that you and all your company are banded together. And as for Aaron, what is he that you grumble against him?"
verses.16:12: Then Moses sent to summon Dathan and Abiram, the sons of Eliab, but they said, "We will not come up!
verses.16:13: Is it a small matter that you have brought us up from a land flowing with milk and honey to put us to death in the wilderness, that you must also completely lord it over us?
verses.16:14: Moreover, you have not brought us into a land flowing with milk and honey, nor have you given us an inheritance of field and vineyard. Will you gouge out the eyes of those men? We will not come up!"
verses.16:15: Then Moses became very angry and said to the LORD, "Pay no regard to their offering. I have not taken a single donkey from them, nor have I harmed a single one of them."
verses.16:16: Then Moses said to Korah, "You and all your company, be present before the LORD, you and they and Aaron, tomorrow.
verses.16:17: And each man take his firepan, put incense on them, and each man present his firepan before the LORD, two hundred fifty firepans; and you and Aaron, each man his firepan."
verses.16:18: So each man took his firepan, and they put fire on them and placed incense on them, and they stood at the entrance of the tent of meeting, along with Moses and Aaron.
verses.16:19: And Korah assembled the entire congregation against them at the entrance of the tent of meeting. Then the glory of the LORD appeared to the entire congregation.
verses.16:20: And the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.16:21: "Separate yourselves from the midst of this congregation, so that I may consume them in an instant."
verses.16:22: But they fell on their faces and said, "God, God of the spirits of all flesh, will one man sin, yet You be enraged against the entire congregation?"
verses.16:23: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.16:24: "Speak to the congregation, saying, 'Withdraw from around the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.'"
verses.16:25: Then Moses got up and went to Dathan and Abiram, and the elders of Israel went after him.
verses.16:26: And he spoke to the congregation, saying, "Move away, please, from the tents of these wicked men, and do not touch anything that belongs to them, or else you will be swept away in all their sins."
verses.16:27: So they withdrew from all around the dwelling of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram. And Dathan and Abiram came out and stood at the entrance of their tents, along with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.
verses.16:28: Then Moses said, "By this you will know that the LORD has sent me to perform all these deeds, that it is not from my own mind:
verses.16:29: If these men die the death of all mankind, and the fate of all mankind is visited on them, then it is not the LORD who has sent me.
verses.16:30: But if the LORD creates something unprecedented, and the ground opens wide its mouth and swallows them and all that belongs to them, and they go down alive to Sheol, then you will know that these men have scorned the LORD."
verses.16:31: It happened, just as he finished speaking all these words, that the ground that was beneath them split open.
verses.16:32: And the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and their households, along with all the people who belonged to Korah and all the possessions.
verses.16:33: So they and all that belonged to them went down alive to Sheol, and the earth covered over them, and they perished from the midst of the assembly.
verses.16:34: And all Israel who were around them fled at their cry, for they said, "The earth might swallow us!"
verses.16:35: Fire also went out from the LORD and devoured the two hundred fifty men who presented the incense.
verses.17:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:2: "Tell Eleazar, the son of Aaron the priest, to lift up the firepans from the midst of the burning, and scatter the fire at a distance, for they have become holy.
verses.17:3: As for the firepans of these men who sinned at the cost of their lives, let them be made into hammered sheets as a plating for the altar, for they presented them before the LORD, and they became holy; and they shall be a sign to the sons of Israel."
verses.17:4: So Eleazar the priest took the bronze firepans that those who were burned had presented, and they were hammered out as a plating for the altar,
verses.17:5: as a reminder to the sons of Israel, so that no outsider, who is not from the offspring of Aaron, should draw near to burn incense before the LORD, and so that he would not become like Korah and like his company, just as the LORD had spoken to him through Moses.
verses.17:6: On the next day, the entire congregation of the sons of Israel grumbled against Moses and against Aaron, saying, "You have put the people of the LORD to death!"
verses.17:7: Now as the congregation was assembling against Moses and against Aaron, they turned toward the tent of meeting, and look, the cloud covered it, and the glory of the LORD appeared.
verses.17:8: Then Moses and Aaron came to the front of the tent of meeting.
verses.17:9: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:10: "Remove yourselves from the midst of this congregation, so that I may consume them in an instant." And they fell on their faces.
verses.17:11: Then Moses said to Aaron, "Take the firepan, put fire from the altar on it, and place incense on it; carry it quickly to the congregation and make atonement for them, for wrath has gone out from the presence of the LORD; the plague has begun!"
verses.17:12: So Aaron took it just as Moses had spoken and ran into the midst of the assembly, and look, the plague had begun among the people. So he put on the incense and made atonement for the people.
verses.17:13: He stood between the dead and the living, and the plague was halted.
verses.17:14: Now those who died in the plague numbered fourteen thousand seven hundred, besides those who died over the matter of Korah.
verses.17:15: Then Aaron returned to Moses at the entrance of the tent of meeting, and the plague had been halted.
verses.17:16: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.17:17: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and take from them a staff for each father's house, from all their leaders according to their fathers' houses, twelve staffs. You shall write each man's name on his staff.
verses.17:18: And you shall write Aaron's name on the staff of Levi, for there is to be one staff for the head of their fathers' house.
verses.17:19: Then you shall deposit them in the tent of meeting before the testimony, where I meet with you.
