verses.17:20: And it will be that the man whom I choose, his staff will sprout; so I will quiet the grumblings of the sons of Israel against Me, which they are grumbling against you."
verses.17:21: So Moses spoke to the sons of Israel, and all their leaders gave him a staff for each leader, according to their fathers' houses, twelve staffs, and Aaron's staff was among their staffs.
verses.17:22: And Moses deposited the staffs before the LORD in the tent of the testimony.
verses.17:23: Now on the next day Moses went into the tent of the testimony, and look, Aaron's staff for the house of Levi had sprouted; it had brought forth buds, bloomed with blossoms, and yielded ripe almonds.
verses.17:24: Then Moses brought out all the staffs from before the LORD to all the sons of Israel; and they looked, and each man took his staff.
verses.17:25: And the LORD said to Moses, "Return Aaron's staff before the testimony for safekeeping as a sign to the sons of rebellion, so that you may bring their grumblings against Me to an end, and they will not die."
verses.17:26: And Moses did this: just as the LORD commanded him, so he did.
verses.17:27: Then the sons of Israel said to Moses, "Look, we are perishing! We are lost, all of us are lost!
verses.17:28: Everyone who draws near, who draws near to the tabernacle of the LORD, dies! Are we to perish altogether?"
verses.18:1: Then the LORD said to Aaron, "You and your sons and your father's house with you shall bear the iniquity of the sanctuary, and you and your sons with you shall bear the iniquity of your priesthood.
verses.18:2: Also bring near with you your brothers, the tribe of Levi, your father's tribe, so that they may be joined to you and minister to you, while you and your sons with you are before the tent of the testimony.
verses.18:3: They shall keep your charge and the charge of the entire tent; only they shall not draw near to the articles of the sanctuary or to the altar, so that neither they nor you will die.
verses.18:4: They shall be joined to you and keep the charge of the tent of meeting for all the service of the tent, and no outsider shall draw near to you.
verses.18:5: And you shall keep the charge of the sanctuary and the charge of the altar, so that there will no longer be wrath upon the sons of Israel.
verses.18:6: And look, I Myself have taken your brothers the Levites from the midst of the sons of Israel; they are a gift to you, given to the LORD to perform the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.18:7: But you and your sons with you shall keep your priesthood for every matter of the altar and for what is inside the curtain, and you shall serve. I give your priesthood as a service of gift, and the outsider who draws near shall be put to death."
verses.18:8: Then the LORD spoke to Aaron, "And look, I Myself have given you the charge of My contributions; all the holy things of the sons of Israel I have given to you as a share, and to your sons as a lasting statute.
verses.18:9: This shall be yours from the most holy things, from the fire: every offering of theirs—every grain offering of theirs, every sin offering of theirs, and every guilt offering of theirs that they return to Me—is most holy, for you and for your sons.
verses.18:10: As a most holy thing you shall eat it; every male may eat it; it shall be holy to you.
verses.18:11: And this is yours: the contribution of their gift, with all the wave offerings of the sons of Israel; I have given them to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as a lasting statute. Everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.18:12: All the best of the fresh oil and all the best of the new wine and the grain—the first of them that they give to the LORD—I have given to you.
verses.18:13: The firstfruits of everything in their land that they bring to the LORD shall be yours; everyone who is clean in your house may eat it.
verses.18:14: Every devoted thing in Israel shall be yours.
verses.18:15: Everything that opens the womb of all flesh, which they present to the LORD, both of man and of animal, shall be yours; yet you shall certainly redeem the firstborn of man, and the firstborn of unclean animals you shall redeem.
verses.18:16: And as for its redemption, from a month old you shall redeem it at your valuation: five shekels of silver by the shekel of the sanctuary—it is twenty gerahs.
verses.18:17: However, you shall not redeem the firstborn of an ox, or the firstborn of a sheep, or the firstborn of a goat; they are holy. You shall splash their blood on the altar and turn their fat into smoke as a fire offering, for a soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.18:18: And their flesh shall be yours; like the breast of the wave offering and like the right thigh, it shall be yours.
verses.18:19: All the contributions of the holy things that the sons of Israel lift up to the LORD I have given to you and to your sons and to your daughters with you as a lasting statute. It is an everlasting covenant of salt before the LORD for you and for your offspring with you."
verses.18:20: Then the LORD said to Aaron, "In their land you shall not inherit, and there shall be no portion for you in their midst; I am your portion and your inheritance in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.18:21: And to the sons of Levi, look, I have given every tithe in Israel as an inheritance, in exchange for their service that they perform—the service of the tent of meeting.
verses.18:22: And the sons of Israel shall no longer draw near to the tent of meeting, to bear sin and die.
verses.18:23: Rather, the Levite himself shall perform the service of the tent of meeting, and they shall bear their iniquity; it shall be a lasting statute throughout your generations, and in the midst of the sons of Israel they shall inherit no inheritance.
verses.18:24: For the tithe of the sons of Israel, which they lift up to the LORD as a contribution, I have given to the Levites as an inheritance; therefore I have said concerning them, 'In the midst of the sons of Israel they shall inherit no inheritance.'"
verses.18:25: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.18:26: "And to the Levites you shall speak and say to them, 'When you take from the sons of Israel the tithe that I have given you from them as your inheritance, then you shall lift up from it a contribution to the LORD, a tithe from the tithe.
verses.18:27: And your contribution shall be reckoned to you like the grain from the threshing floor and like the fullness from the winepress.
verses.18:28: Thus you also shall lift up a contribution to the LORD from all your tithes that you take from the sons of Israel, and from it you shall give the LORD's contribution to Aaron the priest.
verses.18:29: From all your gifts you shall lift up every contribution to the LORD, from all its best, its consecrated part from it.'
verses.18:30: And you shall say to them, 'When you lift up its best from it, then it shall be reckoned to the Levites like the produce of the threshing floor and like the produce of the winepress.
verses.18:31: And you may eat it in any place, you and your household, for it is wages for you in exchange for your service in the tent of meeting.
verses.18:32: And you will bear no sin on account of it when you lift up its best from it; and you shall not profane the holy things of the sons of Israel, so that you will not die.'"
verses.19:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses and to Aaron, saying,
verses.19:2: "This is the statute of the law that the LORD has commanded, saying, 'Speak to the sons of Israel that they bring to you a red cow without defect, in which there is no blemish and upon which a yoke has never come.
verses.19:3: And you shall give it to Eleazar the priest, and he shall bring it outside the camp, and one shall slaughter it before him.
verses.19:4: Then Eleazar the priest shall take some of its blood on his finger and sprinkle some of its blood seven times directly toward the front of the tent of meeting.
verses.19:5: And one shall burn the cow in his sight; its hide and its flesh and its blood, together with its dung, he shall burn.
verses.19:6: Then the priest shall take cedar wood and hyssop and scarlet thread, and throw them into the midst of the burning of the cow.
verses.19:7: Then the priest shall wash his garments and bathe his body in water, and afterward he may come into the camp; yet the priest shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:8: And the one who burns it shall wash his garments in water and bathe his body in water, and he shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:9: Then a clean man shall gather the ashes of the cow and deposit them outside the camp in a clean place; and they shall be for safekeeping for the congregation of the sons of Israel, for water for impurity; it is a purification offering.
verses.19:10: And the one who gathers the ashes of the cow shall wash his garments and be unclean until evening. And this shall be for the sons of Israel and for the sojourner who sojourns in their midst as a lasting statute.
verses.19:11: The one who touches the dead body of any human person shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:12: He shall purify himself with it on the third day and on the seventh day, and he will be clean; but if he does not purify himself on the third day and on the seventh day, he will not be clean.
verses.19:13: Everyone who touches a dead body, a human person who has died, and does not purify himself, has defiled the tabernacle of the LORD, and that person shall be cut off from Israel. Because water for impurity was not splashed on him, he shall be unclean; his uncleanness is still upon him.
verses.19:14: This is the law when a person dies in a tent: everyone who comes into the tent and all that is in the tent shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:15: And every open vessel that has no lid bound with a cord over it is unclean.
verses.19:16: And anyone who in the open field touches one killed by a sword, or a dead body, or a human bone, or a grave, shall be unclean seven days.
verses.19:17: Then for the unclean person they shall take some of the dust from the burning of the purification offering, and one shall put running water over it in a vessel.
verses.19:18: Then a clean man shall take hyssop and dip it in the water, and sprinkle it on the tent and on all the vessels and on the persons who were there, and on the one who touched the bone or the killed person or the dead body or the grave.
verses.19:19: And the clean person shall sprinkle on the unclean person on the third day and on the seventh day; and on the seventh day he shall purify him, and he shall wash his garments and bathe in water, and he shall be clean in the evening.
verses.19:20: But the man who becomes unclean and does not purify himself, that person shall be cut off from the midst of the assembly, for he has defiled the sanctuary of the LORD; water for impurity was not splashed on him; he is unclean.
verses.19:21: And it shall be a lasting statute for them. The one who sprinkles the water for impurity shall wash his garments, and the one who touches the water for impurity shall be unclean until evening.
verses.19:22: And whatever the unclean person touches shall become unclean, and the person who touches it shall be unclean until evening.'"
verses.20:1: The sons of Israel, the entire congregation, arrived in the wilderness of Zin in the first month, and the people remained in Kadesh; Miriam died there, and she was buried there.
verses.20:2: And there was no water for the congregation, so they assembled against Moses and against Aaron.
verses.20:3: The people disputed with Moses and spoke, saying, "If only we had expired when our brothers expired before the LORD!
verses.20:4: And why have you brought the assembly of the LORD into this wilderness, that we and our livestock should die there?
verses.20:5: And why did you bring us up from Egypt to bring us to this bad place? It is not a place of seed, or figs, or grapevines, or pomegranates, and there is no water to drink."
verses.20:6: Moses and Aaron came from before the assembly to the entrance of the tent of meeting, and they fell on their faces, and the glory of the LORD appeared to them.
verses.20:7: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.20:8: "Take the staff and assemble the congregation, you and your brother Aaron. Speak to the rock before their eyes, and it will yield its water; so you will bring out water for them from the rock and give the congregation and their livestock to drink."
verses.20:9: Moses took the staff from the presence of the LORD, just as He had commanded him.
verses.20:10: Moses and Aaron convened the assembly in front of the rock, and he said to them, "Listen now, you rebels! Are we to bring water out of this rock for you?"
verses.20:11: Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, and abundant water came out, so the congregation and their livestock drank.
verses.20:12: And the LORD said to Moses and to Aaron, "Because you did not trust in Me to regard Me as holy before the eyes of the sons of Israel, therefore you will not bring this assembly into the land that I have given to them."
verses.20:13: These are the waters of Meribah, where the sons of Israel disputed with the LORD, and He showed Himself to be holy among them.
verses.20:14: Moses sent messengers from Kadesh to the king of Edom: "This is what your brother Israel says: You yourself know all the hardship that has found us,
verses.20:15: how our fathers went down to Egypt, and we lived in Egypt for many days, and the Egyptians mistreated us and our fathers.
verses.20:16: We cried out to the LORD, and He heard our voice; He sent an angel and brought us out from Egypt. Look, we are now at Kadesh, a city at the edge of your border.
verses.20:17: Let us pass through your land, please. We will not pass through any field or vineyard, nor will we drink well water. We will travel along the King's Road; we will not turn to the right or to the left until we pass through your territory."
verses.20:18: But Edom said to him, "You shall not pass through me, otherwise I will come out to meet you with the sword."
verses.20:19: And the sons of Israel said to him, "We will go up by the highway, and if we drink your water, I and my herds, then I will pay its price. Only, nothing more: let me pass through on my feet."
verses.20:20: He answered, "You shall not pass through." And Edom came out to meet him with a numerous people and with a strong hand.
verses.20:21: Edom refused to let Israel pass through his territory; therefore Israel turned aside from him.
verses.20:22: They set out from Kadesh, and the sons of Israel, the entire congregation, arrived at Mount Hor.
verses.20:23: The LORD said to Moses and to Aaron at Mount Hor, along the border of the land of Edom, saying,
verses.20:24: "Aaron is to be gathered to his kin, for he will not come into the land that I have given to the sons of Israel, because you rebelled against My word at the waters of Meribah.
verses.20:25: Take Aaron and Eleazar his son, and bring them up onto Mount Hor,
verses.20:26: and strip his garments off Aaron and clothe Eleazar his son with them. Then Aaron will be gathered and will die there."
verses.20:27: Moses did as the LORD had commanded, and they went up Mount Hor before the eyes of the entire congregation.
verses.20:28: Moses stripped his garments off Aaron and clothed Eleazar his son with them. Aaron died there at the summit of the mountain, and Moses and Eleazar went down from the mountain.
verses.20:29: When the entire congregation saw that Aaron had expired, they wept for Aaron thirty days, the entire house of Israel.
verses.21:1: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, residing in the Negev, heard that Israel was coming by the road of Atharim; so he fought against Israel and took captives from them.
verses.21:2: Israel vowed a vow to the LORD, saying, "If You certainly give this people into my hand, then I will devote their cities to utter destruction."
verses.21:3: And the LORD listened to the voice of Israel and gave over the Canaanites, and they devoted them and their cities to utter destruction; so they called the name of the place Hormah.
verses.21:4: They set out from Mount Hor along the road to the Sea of Reeds in order to go around the land of Edom, and the soul of the people grew impatient on the way.
verses.21:5: The people spoke against God and against Moses, "Why did you bring us up from Egypt to die in the wilderness? For there is no bread and there is no water, and our soul loathes this wretched bread."
verses.21:6: So the LORD sent out fiery serpents among the people, and they bit the people, and many of the people from Israel died.
verses.21:7: Then the people came to Moses and said, "We have sinned, for we spoke against the LORD and against you. Pray to the LORD so that He will remove the serpents from us." So Moses prayed on behalf of the people.
verses.21:8: The LORD said to Moses, "Make for yourself a fiery serpent and place it on a pole; and it shall be that every person who is bitten, when he sees it, will live."
verses.21:9: Moses made a serpent of bronze and placed it on the pole. And it happened that if a serpent bit a man, he gazed at the serpent of bronze and lived.
verses.21:10: The sons of Israel set out and encamped at Oboth.
verses.21:11: They set out from Oboth and encamped at Iye-abarim, in the wilderness facing Moab, toward the rising of the sun.
verses.21:12: From there they set out and encamped in the Wadi Zered.
verses.21:13: From there they set out and encamped across the Arnon, which is in the wilderness extending from the border of the Amorites, since the Arnon is the border of Moab, between Moab and the Amorites.
verses.21:14: That is why it is said in the Book of the Wars of the LORD: "Waheb in Suphah and the wadis of Arnon,
verses.21:15: and the slope of the wadis that inclines toward the settlement of Ar and leans against the border of Moab."
verses.21:16: From there they went to Beer; that is the well about which the LORD said to Moses, "Gather the people, and I will give water to them."
verses.21:17: Then Israel sang this song: "Rise up, well! Sing in response to it,
verses.21:18: a well that princes dug, that the nobles of the people excavated with a scepter, with their staffs." And from the wilderness they went to Mattanah,
verses.21:19: and from Mattanah to Nahaliel, and from Nahaliel to Bamoth,
verses.21:20: and from Bamoth to the valley that is in the country of Moab, at the summit of Pisgah, which looks out over the wasteland.
verses.21:21: Israel sent messengers to Sihon, the king of the Amorites, saying,
verses.21:22: "Let me pass through your land. We will not turn into any field or vineyard; we will not drink well water. We will travel by the King's Road until we pass through your territory."
verses.21:23: But Sihon did not let Israel pass through his territory. Instead, Sihon gathered all his people and went out into the wilderness to meet Israel; he arrived at Jahaz and fought against Israel.
verses.21:24: Israel struck him down with the edge of the sword and took possession of his land from the Arnon to the Jabbok, as far as the sons of Ammon, because the border of the sons of Ammon was strong.
verses.21:25: So Israel took all of these cities, and Israel settled in all the cities of the Amorites, in Heshbon and in all its towns.
verses.21:26: For Heshbon was the city of Sihon, the king of the Amorites; he had fought against the previous king of Moab and taken his entire land from his hand, as far as the Arnon.
verses.21:27: Therefore those who recite ballads say, "Come to Heshbon; may it be built and established, the city of Sihon!
verses.21:28: For fire went out from Heshbon, a flame from the town of Sihon; it consumed Ar of Moab, the lords of the heights of Arnon.
verses.21:29: Woe to you, Moab! You have perished, people of Chemosh; he has given his sons over as fugitives and his daughters into captivity to Sihon, an Amorite king.
verses.21:30: And we shot them down; Heshbon has perished as far as Dibon, and we laid waste as far as Nophah, which stretches to Medeba."
verses.21:31: So Israel settled in the land of the Amorites.
verses.21:32: Then Moses sent to scout out Jazer, and they seized its towns and drove out the Amorites who were there.
verses.21:33: Next they turned and went up along the road to Bashan. Og, the king of Bashan, came out to meet them, he and all his people, for battle at Edrei.
verses.21:34: The LORD said to Moses, "Do not be afraid of him, for into your hand I have given him, together with all his people and his land. You shall do to him just as you did to Sihon, the king of the Amorites, who resided in Heshbon."
verses.21:35: So they struck down him and his sons and all his people, until no survivor was left to him, and they took possession of his land.
verses.22:1: Then the sons of Israel set out and camped in the plains of Moab, beyond the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.22:2: Now Balak son of Zippor saw everything that Israel had done to the Amorites.
verses.22:3: So Moab was greatly afraid because of the people, for they were numerous; and Moab felt dread because of the sons of Israel.
verses.22:4: Moab said to the elders of Midian, "Now the assembly will lick up everything around us, just as an ox licks up the green growth of the field." Now Balak son of Zippor was king of Moab at that time.
verses.22:5: So he sent messengers to Balaam son of Beor at Pethor, which is by the River, in the land of the sons of his people, to summon him, saying, "Look, a people has come out from Egypt; look, they have covered the surface of the land, and they are dwelling right opposite me.
verses.22:6: Now therefore, please come, curse this people for me, for they are too mighty for me; perhaps I may prevail, so that we strike them and I drive them out of the land. For I know that the one you bless is blessed, and the one you curse is cursed."
verses.22:7: So the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian set out with fees for divination in their hands, and they came to Balaam and spoke Balak's words to him.
verses.22:8: He said to them, "Spend the night here, and I will bring word back to you just as the LORD speaks to me." So the officials of Moab stayed with Balaam.
verses.22:9: Then God came to Balaam and said, "Who are these men with you?"
verses.22:10: Balaam said to God, "Balak son of Zippor, king of Moab, sent to me:
verses.22:11: 'Look, the people coming out from Egypt have covered the surface of the land. Now come, curse them for me; perhaps I will be able to fight against them and drive them out.'"
verses.22:12: God said to Balaam, "You must not go with them; you must not curse the people, for they are blessed."
verses.22:13: So Balaam got up in the morning and said to Balak's officials, "Go to your land, for the LORD has refused to let me go with you."
verses.22:14: So the officials of Moab got up, came to Balak, and said, "Balaam refused to come with us."
verses.22:15: Then Balak again sent officials, more numerous and more distinguished than these.
verses.22:16: They came to Balaam and said to him, "This is what Balak son of Zippor says: 'Please do not hold back from coming to me,
verses.22:17: for I will indeed honor you very highly, and whatever you say to me I will do. And please come, curse this people for me.'"
verses.22:18: Balaam replied and said to Balak's servants, "Even if Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I could not go beyond the command of the LORD my God to do anything small or great.
verses.22:19: Now please stay here tonight, you as well, so that I may know what more the LORD will speak with me."
verses.22:20: Then God came to Balaam by night and said to him, "If the men have come to summon you, rise and go with them; yet only the word that I speak to you, that you must do."
verses.22:21: So Balaam got up in the morning, saddled his female donkey, and went with the officials of Moab.
verses.22:22: But God's anger burned because he was going, and the angel of the LORD stationed himself in the road as an adversary against him. Now he was riding on his donkey, and his two attendants were with him.
verses.22:23: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with his drawn sword in his hand, the donkey turned aside from the road and went into the field. So Balaam struck the donkey to turn her back onto the road.
verses.22:24: Then the angel of the LORD stood in a narrow path of the vineyards, with a wall on this side and a wall on that side.
verses.22:25: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she pressed herself against the wall and pressed Balaam's foot against the wall; so he struck her again.
verses.22:26: Then the angel of the LORD passed on further and stood in a narrow place where there was no way to turn aside to the right or to the left.
verses.22:27: When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, she lay down beneath Balaam. Then Balaam's anger burned, and he struck the donkey with his staff.
verses.22:28: Then the LORD opened the mouth of the donkey, and she said to Balaam, "What have I done to you that you have struck me these three times?"
verses.22:29: Balaam said to the donkey, "Because you have made sport of me! If only a sword were in my hand, right now I would have killed you!"
verses.22:30: The donkey said to Balaam, "Am I not your donkey on which you have ridden all your life up to this day? Have I ever been in the habit of doing this to you?" And he said, "No."
verses.22:31: Then the LORD uncovered Balaam's eyes, and he saw the angel of the LORD standing in the road with his drawn sword in his hand; and he bowed low and prostrated himself on his face.
verses.22:32: The angel of the LORD said to him, "Why have you struck your donkey these three times? Look, I have come out as an adversary, because the way is reckless before me.
verses.22:33: The donkey saw me and turned aside before me these three times. If she had not turned aside from before me, surely by now I would have killed you and kept her alive."
verses.22:34: Balaam said to the angel of the LORD, "I have sinned, for I did not know that you were standing in the road to confront me. Now then, if it is evil in your eyes, I will turn back."
verses.22:35: The angel of the LORD said to Balaam, "Go with the men, yet only the word that I speak to you, that you must speak." So Balaam went with Balak's officials.
verses.22:36: When Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him at the city of Moab, which is on the border of the Arnon, at the far edge of the border.
verses.22:37: Balak said to Balaam, "Did I not indeed send to you to summon you? Why did you not come to me? Am I truly unable to honor you?"
verses.22:38: Balaam said to Balak, "Look, I have come to you! Now, am I at all able to speak anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I will speak."
verses.22:39: Then Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kiriath-huzoth.
verses.22:40: And Balak sacrificed cattle and sheep, and sent from them to Balaam and to the officials who were with him.
verses.22:41: In the morning, Balak took Balaam and brought him up to Bamoth-baal, and from there he saw the outer edge of the people.
verses.23:1: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here."
verses.23:2: Balak did just as Balaam had spoken, and Balak and Balaam offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.23:3: Then Balaam said to Balak, "Station yourself beside your burnt offering, and I will go; perhaps the LORD will come to meet me, and whatever He shows me I will tell you." So he went to a bare height.
verses.23:4: Then God met Balaam, and he said to Him, "I have set in order the seven altars, and I have offered up a bull and a ram on each altar."
verses.23:5: And the LORD put a word in Balaam's mouth and said, "Return to Balak, and in this way you shall speak."
verses.23:6: So he returned to him, and there he was, standing beside his burnt offering, he and all the officials of Moab.
verses.23:7: Then he took up his oracle and said, "From Aram Balak has led me, the king of Moab from the mountains of the east: 'Come, curse Jacob for me, and come, denounce Israel!'
verses.23:8: How shall I curse the one God has not cursed? And how shall I denounce the one the LORD has not denounced?
verses.23:9: For from the summit of the crags I see him, and from the hills I gaze upon him; look, a people that dwells apart, and among the nations it does not reckon itself.
verses.23:10: Who has counted the dust of Jacob, or the number of a fourth part of Israel? May my soul die the death of the upright, and may my latter end be like his!"
verses.23:11: Then Balak said to Balaam, "What have you done to me? I took you to curse my enemies, and look, you have thoroughly blessed them!"
verses.23:12: He replied and said, "What the LORD puts in my mouth—must I not take care to speak it?"
verses.23:13: Then Balak said to him, "Please come with me to another place from which you can see them; you will see only their outer edge and will not see all of them. And curse them for me from there."
verses.23:14: So he took him to the field of Zophim, to the summit of Pisgah, and he built seven altars and offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.23:15: He said to Balak, "Station yourself here beside your burnt offering, while I myself am met over there."
verses.23:16: Then the LORD met Balaam, put a word in his mouth, and said, "Return to Balak, and in this way you shall speak."
verses.23:17: So he came to him, and there he was, standing beside his burnt offering, and the officials of Moab were with him. And Balak said to him, "What has the LORD spoken?"
verses.23:18: Then he took up his oracle and said, "Rise, Balak, and hear; give ear to me, son of Zippor!
verses.23:19: God is no man, that He should lie, nor a son of man, that He should relent. Has He Himself said, and will He not act? Or has He spoken, and will He not establish it?
verses.23:20: Look, I have received a charge to bless; He has blessed, and I cannot turn it back.
verses.23:21: He has not observed iniquity in Jacob, nor has He seen trouble in Israel; the LORD his God is with him, and the shout of a king is in his midst.
verses.23:22: God brings them out from Egypt; He is to him like the horns of a wild ox.
verses.23:23: For no enchantment is against Jacob, and no divination is against Israel; at this time it will be said of Jacob and of Israel, 'What God has done!'
verses.23:24: Look, a people—like a lioness it rises, and like a lion it lifts itself up; it will not lie down until it devours prey and drinks the blood of those killed."
verses.23:25: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Neither curse them at all, nor bless them at all!"
verses.23:26: Balaam replied and said to Balak, "Did I not speak to you, saying, 'Everything that the LORD speaks, that I will do'?"
verses.23:27: Then Balak said to Balaam, "Please come, I will take you to another place; perhaps it will be right in the eyes of God, and you will curse them for me from there."
verses.23:28: So Balak took Balaam to the summit of Peor, which overlooks the wasteland.
verses.23:29: Balaam said to Balak, "Build seven altars for me here, and prepare seven bulls and seven rams for me here."
verses.23:30: And Balak did just as Balaam had said, and he offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.
verses.24:1: When Balaam saw that it was good in the eyes of the LORD to bless Israel, he did not go, as on previous occasions, to meet with omens, but instead set his face toward the wilderness.
verses.24:2: Balaam raised his eyes and saw Israel dwelling by its tribes, and the Spirit of God came upon him.
verses.24:3: He took up his oracle and said, "The declaration of Balaam, son of Beor, and the declaration of the man with an opened eye,
verses.24:4: the declaration of one who hears the sayings of God, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, yet with eyes uncovered:
verses.24:5: How good are your tents, Jacob, your dwellings, Israel!
verses.24:6: Like valleys they spread out, like gardens along a river, like aloe trees that the LORD planted, like cedars along the waters.
verses.24:7: Water will pour from his buckets, and his seed will be in abundant waters; and his king will rise higher than Agag, and his kingdom will be lifted high.
verses.24:8: God brings him out of Egypt; he has towering horns like a wild ox. He will devour nations, his adversaries, crunch their bones, and strike through with his arrows.
verses.24:9: He crouches, he lies down like a lion and like a lioness; who will make him rise? Each one who blesses you is blessed, and each one who curses you is cursed."
verses.24:10: Then Balak's anger burned against Balaam, and he clapped his hands together. And Balak said to Balaam, "I summoned you to curse my enemies, yet look, you have thoroughly blessed them these three times.
verses.24:11: So now, flee away to your place. I said, 'I will greatly honor you,' yet look, the LORD has kept you from honor."
verses.24:12: And Balaam said to Balak, "Did I not also speak to your messengers whom you sent to me, saying,
verses.24:13: 'If Balak were to give me his house full of silver and gold, I would be unable to transgress the command of the LORD, to do good or bad from my own heart; whatever the LORD speaks, that I will speak'?
verses.24:14: And now, see, I am going to my people; come, let me counsel you about what this people will do to your people in the latter days."
verses.24:15: He took up his oracle and said, "The declaration of Balaam, son of Beor, and the declaration of the man with an opened eye,
verses.24:16: the declaration of one who hears the sayings of God and knows the knowledge of the Most High, who sees the vision of the Almighty, falling down, yet with eyes uncovered:
verses.24:17: I see him, yet not now; I gaze upon him, yet not near. A star will march forth from Jacob, and a scepter will arise from Israel; it will shatter the temples of Moab and demolish all the sons of Sheth.
verses.24:18: Edom will become a possession, and Seir, his enemies, will become a possession, while Israel acts with valor.
verses.24:19: And one from Jacob will hold dominion, and will destroy any survivor from a city."
verses.24:20: Then he saw Amalek, lifted up his discourse, and said, "First of the nations is Amalek, yet his end leads to destruction."
verses.24:21: Then he saw the Kenite, lifted up his discourse, and said, "Firm is your dwelling place, and set in the crag is your nest.
verses.24:22: Yet Kain will be consumed; how long until Asshur carries you away captive?"
verses.24:23: And he lifted up his discourse and said, "Alas, who will live when God appoints this?
verses.24:24: Ships from the shore of Kittim will afflict Asshur and will afflict Eber, and he also will go to destruction."
verses.24:25: Then Balaam got up, set out, and returned to his place, and Balak also went on his way.
verses.25:1: Israel stayed in Shittim, and the people began to engage in sexual immorality with the daughters of Moab.
verses.25:2: They invited the people to the sacrifices of their gods; then the people ate and prostrated themselves to their gods.
verses.25:3: Thus Israel bound itself to Baal of Peor, and the LORD's anger burned against Israel.
verses.25:4: And the LORD said to Moses, "Take all the heads of the people and impale them for the LORD facing the sun, so that the burning anger of the LORD may turn back from Israel."
verses.25:5: Then Moses said to the judges of Israel, "Each of you, kill his men who have bound themselves to Baal of Peor."
verses.25:6: And look, a man from the sons of Israel came and brought a Midianite woman near to his brothers before the eyes of Moses and before the eyes of the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, while they were weeping at the entrance of the tent of meeting.
verses.25:7: Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, saw this, got up from the midst of the congregation, and took a spear in his hand.
verses.25:8: He went after the man of Israel into the tent chamber and pierced the two of them, the man of Israel and the woman, into her belly. Then the plague was halted from the sons of Israel.
verses.25:9: And those who died in the plague were twenty-four thousand.
verses.25:10: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:11: "Phinehas, son of Eleazar, son of Aaron the priest, has turned back My wrath from the sons of Israel by being zealous with My zeal in their midst, so that I did not put an end to the sons of Israel in My zeal.
verses.25:12: Therefore say, 'Look, I am giving him My covenant of peace,
verses.25:13: and it will be for him and for his offspring after him a covenant of an everlasting priesthood, because he was zealous for his God and made atonement for the sons of Israel.'"
verses.25:14: Now the name of the man of Israel who was struck down, the one who was struck down with the Midianite woman, was Zimri, son of Salu, a leader of a father's house among the Simeonites.
verses.25:15: And the name of the Midianite woman who was struck down was Cozbi, daughter of Zur; he was the head of the clans of a father's house in Midian.
verses.25:16: The LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.25:17: "Treat the Midianites as enemies and strike them down,
verses.25:18: for they are treating you as enemies with their schemes by which they schemed against you in the matter of Peor, and in the matter of Cozbi, daughter of a leader of Midian, their sister, who was struck down on the day of the plague over the matter of Peor."
verses.26:1: that the LORD said to Moses and to Eleazar son of Aaron the priest:
verses.26:2: "Take a head count of the entire congregation of the sons of Israel, from twenty years old and above, according to their fathers' houses, everyone who goes out to military service in Israel."
verses.26:3: So Moses and Eleazar the priest spoke with them in the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan at Jericho, saying,
verses.26:4: "From twenty years old and above," just as the LORD had commanded Moses. Now the sons of Israel who came out from the land of Egypt were:
verses.26:5: Reuben, the firstborn of Israel. The sons of Reuben: from Hanoch, the clan of the Hanochites; from Pallu, the clan of the Palluites;
verses.26:6: from Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; from Carmi, the clan of the Carmites.
verses.26:7: These are the clans of the Reubenites, and those registered among them were forty-three thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.26:8: Now the sons of Pallu: Eliab.
verses.26:9: And the sons of Eliab were Nemuel, Dathan, and Abiram. These are the same Dathan and Abiram, the summoned men of the congregation, who waged strife against Moses and against Aaron in the congregation of Korah, when they waged strife against the LORD.
verses.26:10: Then the earth opened its mouth and swallowed them and Korah at the death of the congregation, as the fire consumed two hundred fifty men, and they became a warning sign.
verses.26:11: Yet the sons of Korah did not die.
verses.26:12: The sons of Simeon according to their clans: from Nemuel, the clan of the Nemuelites; from Jamin, the clan of the Jaminites; from Jachin, the clan of the Jachinites;
verses.26:13: from Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites; from Shaul, the clan of the Shaulites.
verses.26:14: These are the clans of the Simeonites: twenty-two thousand two hundred.
verses.26:15: The sons of Judah: Er and Onan; and Er and Onan died in the land of Canaan.
verses.26:16: So the sons of Judah according to their clans were: from Shelah, the clan of the Shelanites; from Perez, the clan of the Perezites; from Zerah, the clan of the Zerahites.
verses.26:17: And the sons of Perez were: from Hezron, the clan of the Hezronites; from Hamul, the clan of the Hamulites.
verses.26:18: These are the clans of Judah according to those registered among them: seventy-six thousand five hundred.
verses.26:19: The sons of Issachar according to their clans: from Tola, the clan of the Tolaites; from Puvah, the clan of the Punites;
verses.26:20: from Jashub, the clan of the Jashubites; from Shimron, the clan of the Shimronites.
verses.26:21: These are the clans of Issachar according to those registered among them: sixty-four thousand three hundred.
verses.26:22: The sons of Zebulun according to their clans: from Sered, the clan of the Seredites; from Elon, the clan of the Elonites; from Jahleel, the clan of the Jahleelites.
verses.26:23: These are the clans of the Zebulunites according to those registered among them: sixty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:24: The sons of Gad according to their clans: from Zephon, the clan of the Zephonites; from Haggi, the clan of the Haggites; from Shuni, the clan of the Shunites;
verses.26:25: from Ozni, the clan of the Oznites; from Eri, the clan of the Erites;
verses.26:26: from Arod, the clan of the Arodites; from Areli, the clan of the Arelites.
verses.26:27: These are the clans of the sons of Gad according to those registered among them: forty thousand five hundred.
verses.26:28: The sons of Asher according to their clans: from Imnah, the clan of the Imnites; from Ishvi, the clan of the Ishvites; from Beriah, the clan of the Beriites.
verses.26:29: Of the sons of Beriah: from Heber, the clan of the Heberites; from Malchiel, the clan of the Malchielites.
verses.26:30: And the name of Asher's daughter was Serah.
verses.26:31: These are the clans of the sons of Asher according to those registered among them: fifty-three thousand four hundred.
verses.26:32: The sons of Joseph according to their clans: Manasseh and Ephraim.
verses.26:33: The sons of Manasseh: from Machir, the clan of the Machirites; and Machir fathered Gilead; from Gilead, the clan of the Gileadites.
verses.26:34: These are the sons of Gilead: from Iezer, the clan of the Iezerites; from Helek, the clan of the Helekites;
verses.26:35: and from Asriel, the clan of the Asrielites; and from Shechem, the clan of the Shechemites;
verses.26:36: and from Shemida, the clan of the Shemidaites; and from Hepher, the clan of the Hepherites.
verses.26:37: And Zelophehad son of Hepher had no sons, only daughters; and the names of Zelophehad's daughters were Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.26:38: These are the clans of Manasseh, and those registered among them were fifty-two thousand seven hundred.
verses.26:39: These are the sons of Ephraim according to their clans: from Shuthelah, the clan of the Shuthelahites; from Becher, the clan of the Becherites; from Tahan, the clan of the Tahanites.
verses.26:40: And these are the sons of Shuthelah: from Eran, the clan of the Eranites.
verses.26:41: These are the clans of the sons of Ephraim according to those registered among them: thirty-two thousand five hundred. These are the sons of Joseph according to their clans.
verses.26:42: The sons of Benjamin according to their clans: from Bela, the clan of the Belaites; from Ashbel, the clan of the Ashbelites; from Ahiram, the clan of the Ahiramites;
verses.26:43: from Shephupham, the clan of the Shuphamites; from Hupham, the clan of the Huphamites.
verses.26:44: And the sons of Bela were Ard and Naaman: the clan of the Ardites; from Naaman, the clan of the Naamites.
verses.26:45: These are the sons of Benjamin according to their clans, and those registered among them were forty-five thousand six hundred.
verses.26:46: These are the sons of Dan according to their clans: from Shuham, the clan of the Shuhamites. These are the clans of Dan according to their clans.
verses.26:47: All the clans of the Shuhamites according to those registered among them: sixty-four thousand four hundred.
verses.26:48: The sons of Naphtali according to their clans: from Jahzeel, the clan of the Jahzeelites; from Guni, the clan of the Gunites;
verses.26:49: from Jezer, the clan of the Jezerites; from Shillem, the clan of the Shillemites.
verses.26:50: These are the clans of Naphtali according to their clans, and those registered among them were forty-five thousand four hundred.
verses.26:51: These are those registered of the sons of Israel: six hundred one thousand seven hundred thirty.
verses.26:52: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.26:53: "Among these the land shall be apportioned as an inheritance by the number of names.
verses.26:54: For the larger you shall enlarge its inheritance, and for the smaller you shall reduce its inheritance; each shall be given its inheritance in proportion to its registered men.
verses.26:55: Only by lot shall the land be apportioned; they shall inherit according to the names of their fathers' tribes.
verses.26:56: According to the decision of the lot, its inheritance shall be apportioned between large and small."
verses.26:57: And these are those registered of the Levites according to their clans: from Gershon, the clan of the Gershonites; from Kohath, the clan of the Kohathites; from Merari, the clan of the Merarites.
verses.26:58: These are the clans of Levi: the clan of the Libnites, the clan of the Hebronites, the clan of the Mahlites, the clan of the Mushites, the clan of the Korahites. And Kohath fathered Amram.
verses.26:59: And the name of Amram's wife was Jochebed, daughter of Levi, who was born to Levi in Egypt; and to Amram she bore Aaron, Moses, and Miriam their sister.
verses.26:60: And Nadab and Abihu, Eleazar and Ithamar were born to Aaron.
verses.26:61: Yet Nadab and Abihu died when they presented unauthorized fire before the LORD.
verses.26:62: And those registered among them were twenty-three thousand, every male from a month old and above; for they were not registered among the sons of Israel, because no inheritance was given to them among the sons of Israel.
verses.26:63: These are those registered by Moses and Eleazar the priest, who registered the sons of Israel in the plains of Moab, beside the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.26:64: And among these there was not a man from those registered by Moses and Aaron the priest, who registered the sons of Israel in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.26:65: For the LORD had said concerning them, "They will certainly die in the wilderness." And not a man of them remained, except Caleb son of Jephunneh and Joshua son of Nun.
verses.27:1: Then the daughters of Zelophehad—son of Hepher, son of Gilead, son of Machir, son of Manasseh, of the clans of Manasseh son of Joseph—approached. And these are the names of his daughters: Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, and Tirzah.
verses.27:2: They stood before Moses, and before Eleazar the priest, and before the leaders and all the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting, saying,
verses.27:3: "Our father died in the wilderness, and he was not in the midst of the congregation that banded together against the LORD in the congregation of Korah; instead, he died in his own sin, and he had no sons.
verses.27:4: Why should our father's name be removed from the midst of his clan because he had no son? Give us a holding among our father's brothers."
verses.27:5: So Moses presented their case before the LORD.
verses.27:6: And the LORD said to Moses, saying,
verses.27:7: "The daughters of Zelophehad are speaking rightly. You shall certainly give them a holding of inheritance among their father's brothers, and you shall transfer their father's inheritance to them.
verses.27:8: And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'When a man dies and has no son, then you shall transfer his inheritance to his daughter.
verses.27:9: And if he has no daughter, then you shall give his inheritance to his brothers.
verses.27:10: And if he has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his father's brothers.
verses.27:11: And if his father has no brothers, then you shall give his inheritance to his closest relative from his clan, and he shall take possession of it.'" And it shall be a statute of judgment for the sons of Israel, just as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.27:12: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Go up to this mountain of the Abarim and see the land that I have given to the sons of Israel.
verses.27:13: Once you have seen it, you as well shall be gathered to your people, just as your brother Aaron was gathered,
verses.27:14: because in the wilderness of Zin, during the contention of the congregation, you rebelled against My command to sanctify Me at the waters in their sight." Those are the waters of Meribah of Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin.
verses.27:15: Then Moses spoke to the LORD, saying,
verses.27:16: "May the LORD, God of the spirits of all flesh, appoint a man over the congregation,
verses.27:17: who will go out before them and who will come in before them, and who will bring them out and who will bring them in, so that the congregation of the LORD will not be like a flock that has no shepherd."
verses.27:18: Then the LORD said to Moses, "Take for yourself Joshua son of Nun, a man in whom is spirit, and lay your hand upon him;
verses.27:19: and have him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation, and charge him in their sight.
verses.27:20: And you shall place some of your dignity upon him, so that all the congregation of the sons of Israel may obey.
verses.27:21: And before Eleazar the priest he shall stand, who will inquire for him by the judgment of the Urim before the LORD. At his word they shall go out, and at his word they shall come in—he, and all the sons of Israel with him, and all the congregation."
verses.27:22: So Moses did just as the LORD commanded him. He took Joshua and had him stand before Eleazar the priest and before all the congregation.
verses.27:23: Then he laid his hands upon him and charged him, just as the LORD had spoken by the hand of Moses.
verses.28:1: Then the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.28:2: "Command the sons of Israel and say to them, 'My offering—My food for My fire offerings, My soothing fragrance—you shall take care to present to Me at its appointed time.'
verses.28:3: And you shall say to them, 'This is the fire offering that you shall present to the LORD: two unblemished male lambs a year old each day, as a continual burnt offering.
verses.28:4: The one lamb you shall prepare in the morning, and the second lamb you shall prepare at twilight,
verses.28:5: and one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a grain offering, mixed with a quarter of a hin of beaten oil.
verses.28:6: It is a continual burnt offering that was prepared at Mount Sinai for a soothing fragrance, a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.28:7: And its drink offering shall be a quarter of a hin for the one lamb; in the sanctuary pour out a drink offering of strong drink to the LORD.
verses.28:8: And the second lamb you shall prepare at twilight; like the grain offering of the morning and like its drink offering you shall prepare it, a fire offering of soothing fragrance to the LORD.
verses.28:9: And on the Sabbath day: two unblemished male lambs a year old, and two tenth-measures of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, and its drink offering.
verses.28:10: This is the burnt offering of each Sabbath on its Sabbath, in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:11: And at the beginnings of your months you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls of the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old, unblemished;
verses.28:12: and three tenth-measures of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each bull; and two tenth-measures of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for the one ram;
verses.28:13: and one tenth-measure each of fine flour as a grain offering, mixed with oil, for each lamb—a burnt offering of soothing fragrance, a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.28:14: And their drink offerings of wine shall be half a hin for each bull, a third of a hin for the ram, and a quarter of a hin for each lamb. This is the burnt offering of each month in its month, for the months of the year.
verses.28:15: Also one male goat for a sin offering to the LORD shall be prepared in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:16: And in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, is the Passover to the LORD.
verses.28:17: And on the fifteenth day of this month is a festival; for seven days unleavened bread shall be eaten.
verses.28:18: On the first day there shall be a holy assembly; you shall not do any occupational work.
verses.28:19: And you shall present a fire offering, a burnt offering to the LORD: two bulls of the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old; they shall be unblemished for you.
verses.28:20: And their grain offering shall be fine flour mixed with oil; you shall prepare three tenth-measures for each bull and two tenth-measures for the ram.
verses.28:21: One tenth-measure each you shall prepare for each lamb, for the seven lambs;
verses.28:22: and one male goat for a sin offering, to make atonement for you.
verses.28:23: Apart from the morning burnt offering, which is for the continual burnt offering, you shall prepare these.
verses.28:24: Like these you shall prepare each day for seven days—the food of a fire offering of soothing fragrance to the LORD; it shall be prepared in addition to the continual burnt offering and its drink offering.
verses.28:25: And on the seventh day there shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do any occupational work.
verses.28:26: Also on the day of the firstfruits, when you present a new grain offering to the LORD at your Weeks, there shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do any occupational work.
verses.28:27: And you shall present a burnt offering for a soothing fragrance to the LORD: two bulls of the herd, one ram, and seven male lambs a year old;
verses.28:28: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenth-measures for each bull, two tenth-measures for the one ram,
verses.28:29: one tenth-measure each for each lamb, for the seven lambs;
verses.28:30: one male goat to make atonement for you.
verses.28:31: Apart from the continual burnt offering and its grain offering you shall prepare them—they shall be unblemished for you—along with their drink offerings.
verses.29:1: And in the seventh month, on the first of the month, there shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do any occupational work. It shall be a day of trumpet blasts for you.
verses.29:2: And you shall prepare a burnt offering for a soothing fragrance to the LORD: one bull from the herd, one ram, seven one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:3: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenth-measures for the bull, two tenth-measures for the ram,
verses.29:4: and one tenth-measure for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:5: and one male goat as a sin offering, to make atonement for you,
verses.29:6: besides the burnt offering of the new moon and its grain offering, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings according to their ordinance, for a soothing fragrance, a fire offering to the LORD.
verses.29:7: And on the tenth of this seventh month there shall be a holy assembly for you, and you shall afflict your souls; you shall not do any work.
verses.29:8: And you shall present a burnt offering to the LORD, a soothing fragrance: one bull from the herd, one ram, seven one-year-old male lambs—they shall be unblemished for you;
verses.29:9: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenth-measures for the bull, two tenth-measures for the one ram,
verses.29:10: one tenth-measure each for each lamb of the seven lambs;
verses.29:11: one male goat as a sin offering, besides the sin offering of atonement, and the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:12: And on the fifteenth day of the seventh month there shall be a holy assembly for you; you shall not do any occupational work, and you shall celebrate a festival to the LORD for seven days.
verses.29:13: And you shall present a burnt offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD: thirteen bulls from the herd, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs—they shall be unblemished;
verses.29:14: and their grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil: three tenth-measures for each bull of the thirteen bulls, two tenth-measures for each ram of the two rams,
verses.29:15: and one tenth-measure each for each lamb of the fourteen lambs;
verses.29:16: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:17: And on the second day: twelve bulls from the herd, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:18: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:19: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering, and their drink offerings.
verses.29:20: And on the third day: eleven bulls, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:21: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:22: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:23: And on the fourth day: ten bulls, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:24: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:25: and one male goat as a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:26: And on the fifth day: nine bulls, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:27: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:28: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:29: And on the sixth day: eight bulls, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:30: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:31: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offerings.
verses.29:32: And on the seventh day: seven bulls, two rams, fourteen one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:33: and their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bulls, for the rams, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to their ordinance;
verses.29:34: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering, its grain offering, and its drink offering.
verses.29:35: On the eighth day there shall be a solemn assembly for you; you shall not do any occupational work.
verses.29:36: And you shall present a burnt offering, a fire offering of a soothing fragrance to the LORD: one bull, one ram, seven one-year-old male lambs, unblemished;
verses.29:37: their grain offering and their drink offerings for the bull, for the ram, and for the lambs, according to their number, according to the ordinance;
verses.29:38: and one male goat for a sin offering, besides the continual burnt offering and its grain offering and its drink offering.
verses.29:39: These you shall prepare for the LORD at your appointed times, apart from your vows and your freewill offerings, for your burnt offerings, for your grain offerings, for your drink offerings, and for your peace offerings.'"
verses.30:1: And Moses spoke to the sons of Israel according to all that the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.30:2: Then Moses spoke to the heads of the tribes of the sons of Israel, saying, "This is the word that the LORD has commanded:
verses.30:3: When a man vows a vow to the LORD, or swears an oath to bind an obligation upon himself, he shall not profane his word; he shall do according to everything that goes out from his mouth.
verses.30:4: And when a woman vows a vow to the LORD and binds an obligation in her father's house, in her youth,
verses.30:5: and her father hears her vow and her obligation that she has bound upon herself, and her father keeps silent toward her, then all her vows shall stand, and every obligation that she has bound upon herself shall stand.
verses.30:6: But if her father overrules her on the day he hears of it, not one of her vows or her obligations that she has bound upon herself shall stand; and the LORD will pardon her, because her father overruled her.
verses.30:7: And if she indeed marries a husband while her vows are upon her, or a hasty utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself,
verses.30:8: and her husband hears of it, and on the day he hears of it keeps silent toward her, then her vows shall stand, and her obligations that she has bound upon herself shall stand.
verses.30:9: But if on the day her husband hears of it he overrules her, then he nullifies her vow that is upon her and the hasty utterance of her lips by which she has bound herself; and the LORD will pardon her.
verses.30:10: And as for the vow of a widow or a divorced woman, everything that she has bound upon herself shall stand upon her.
verses.30:11: And if she vows in her husband's house, or binds an obligation upon herself with an oath,
verses.30:12: and her husband hears of it and keeps silent toward her, and does not overrule her, then all her vows shall stand, and every obligation that she has bound upon herself shall stand.
verses.30:13: But if her husband indeed nullifies them on the day he hears of them, nothing that goes out from her lips concerning her vows or concerning the obligation upon herself shall stand; her husband has nullified them, and the LORD will pardon her.
verses.30:14: Every vow and every oath of obligation to afflict the soul, her husband may uphold it, or her husband may nullify it.
verses.30:15: But if her husband keeps completely silent toward her from day to day, then he upholds all her vows or all her obligations that are upon her; he has upheld them, because he kept silent toward her on the day he heard of them.
verses.30:16: But if he indeed nullifies them after hearing of them, then he shall bear her iniquity."
verses.30:17: These are the statutes that the LORD commanded Moses, between a man and his wife, between a father and his daughter in her youth, in her father's house.
verses.31:1: And the LORD spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.31:2: "Exact the vengeance of the sons of Israel from the Midianites; after that you will be gathered to your people."
verses.31:3: And Moses spoke to the people, saying, "Equip men from among you for the campaign, and let them move against Midian to inflict the vengeance of the LORD on Midian.
verses.31:4: A thousand per tribe, a thousand per tribe, from all the tribes of Israel you shall send to the campaign."
verses.31:5: So there were supplied out of the thousands of Israel a thousand per tribe, twelve thousand equipped for the campaign.
verses.31:6: And Moses sent them, a thousand per tribe, to the campaign—them and Phinehas son of Eleazar the priest to the campaign—with the vessels of the sanctuary and the alarm trumpets in his hand.
verses.31:7: And they campaigned against Midian, as the LORD had commanded Moses, and they killed every male.
verses.31:8: And they killed the kings of Midian in addition to their fallen—Evi, Rekem, Zur, Hur, and Reba, the five kings of Midian—and Balaam son of Beor they killed with the sword.
verses.31:9: And the sons of Israel took the women of Midian and their little ones captive, and all their animals and all their herds and all their wealth they plundered.
verses.31:10: And all their cities in their dwelling places and all their encampments they burned with fire.
verses.31:11: And they took all the spoil and all the booty, of both people and animals.
verses.31:12: And they brought the captives, the booty, and the spoil to Moses and to Eleazar the priest and to the congregation of the sons of Israel, to the camp in the plains of Moab, which are by the Jordan at Jericho.
verses.31:13: And Moses, Eleazar the priest, and all the chieftains of the congregation went out to meet them outside the camp.
verses.31:14: And Moses grew furious with the appointed officers of the force, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, who were coming from the battle campaign.
verses.31:15: And Moses said to them, "Have you kept every female alive?
verses.31:16: Look, these were the ones who, by the word of Balaam, brought the sons of Israel to commit unfaithfulness against the LORD in the matter of Peor, and the plague was in the congregation of the LORD.
verses.31:17: And now, kill every male among the little ones, and kill every woman who has known a man by lying with a male.
verses.31:18: But all the little ones among the women who have not known lying with a male, keep alive for yourselves.
verses.31:19: And as for you, encamp outside the camp seven days; everyone who has killed a person and everyone who has touched anyone killed, you shall purify yourselves on the third day and on the seventh day, you and your captives.
verses.31:20: And every garment, every article of leather, everything made of goat hair, and every article of wood you shall purify."
verses.31:21: And Eleazar the priest said to the men of the army who had gone into battle, "This is the statute of the law which the LORD commanded Moses:
verses.31:22: However, the gold and the silver, the bronze, the iron, the tin, and the lead—
verses.31:23: everything that can go into the fire you shall pass through the fire, and it will be clean; still, it must be purified with water for impurity. And anything that cannot go into the fire you shall pass through the water.
verses.31:24: And you shall wash your garments on the seventh day and you will be clean, and after that you may come into the camp."
verses.31:25: And the LORD said to Moses, saying,
verses.31:26: "Take a count of the captured booty, of both people and animals, you and Eleazar the priest and the heads of the fathers of the congregation;
verses.31:27: and divide the booty in half between those who engaged in the battle, who went out to the campaign, and all the congregation.
verses.31:28: And set apart a tribute for the LORD from the men of battle who went out to the campaign: one living being out of five hundred, from the people, from the cattle, from the donkeys, and from the sheep.
verses.31:29: From their half you shall take it, and you shall give it to Eleazar the priest as the LORD's contribution.
verses.31:30: And from the half belonging to the sons of Israel you shall take one selected out of fifty—from the people, from the cattle, from the donkeys, and from the sheep, from all the animals—and give them to the Levites, the keepers of the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD."
verses.31:31: So Moses and Eleazar the priest did just as the LORD commanded Moses.
verses.31:32: Now the booty, the remainder of the plunder that the troops of the army had plundered, was six hundred seventy-five thousand sheep,
verses.31:35: and human persons, from the women who had not known lying with a male—thirty-two thousand persons in all.
verses.31:36: And the half, the share of those who went out on the campaign, was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred sheep in number,
verses.31:37: and the tribute for the LORD from the sheep was six hundred seventy-five.
verses.31:38: And the cattle were thirty-six thousand, and their tribute for the LORD was seventy-two.
verses.31:39: And the donkeys were thirty thousand five hundred, and their tribute for the LORD was sixty-one.
verses.31:40: And the human persons were sixteen thousand, and their tribute for the LORD was thirty-two persons.
verses.31:41: And Moses gave the tribute, the LORD's contribution, to Eleazar the priest, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.31:42: And from the half of the sons of Israel, which Moses had divided off from the men who campaigned—
verses.31:43: now the congregation's half was three hundred thirty-seven thousand five hundred from the sheep,
verses.31:45: and thirty thousand five hundred donkeys,
verses.31:47: Moses took from the half of the sons of Israel the selected share, one out of fifty, from the people and from the animals, and gave them to the Levites, the keepers of the charge of the tabernacle of the LORD, just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
verses.31:48: Then the appointed officers who were over the thousands of the army, the commanders of thousands and the commanders of hundreds, drew near to Moses,
verses.31:49: and they said to Moses, "Your servants have taken a count of the men of battle who are under our hand, and not one man of us is missing.
verses.31:50: So we have presented the LORD's offering, what each man found in articles of gold—armlets and bracelets, signet rings, earrings, and beaded ornaments—to make atonement for our lives before the LORD."
verses.31:51: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from them, every article of craftsmanship.
verses.31:52: And all the gold of the contribution that they set apart for the LORD was sixteen thousand seven hundred fifty shekels, from the commanders of thousands and from the commanders of hundreds.
verses.31:53: The men of the army had plundered, each man for himself.
verses.31:54: And Moses and Eleazar the priest took the gold from the commanders of thousands and of hundreds, and they brought it into the tent of meeting as a reminder for the sons of Israel before the LORD.
verses.32:1: Now the sons of Reuben and the sons of Gad had abundant livestock, exceedingly numerous; and they saw the land of Jazer and the land of Gilead, and look, the place was a place for livestock.
verses.32:2: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben came and spoke to Moses, to Eleazar the priest, and to the leaders of the congregation, saying,
verses.32:3: "Ataroth, Dibon, Jazer, Nimrah, Heshbon, Elealeh, Sebam, Nebo, and Beon,
verses.32:4: the land that the LORD struck down before the congregation of Israel, is a land for livestock, and your servants have livestock."
verses.32:5: And they said, "If we have found favor in your eyes, may this land be given to your servants for a possession; do not make us cross the Jordan."
verses.32:6: Then Moses said to the sons of Gad and to the sons of Reuben, "Will your brothers go into battle while you stay here?
verses.32:7: And why do you turn away the heart of the sons of Israel from crossing into the land that the LORD has given them?
verses.32:8: Your fathers acted in this way when I sent them from Kadesh-barnea to see the land.
verses.32:9: They went up as far as the Valley of Eshcol and saw the land, and they turned away the heart of the sons of Israel so that they would not enter the land that the LORD had given them.
verses.32:10: Then the anger of the LORD burned on that day, and He swore, saying,
verses.32:11: 'Surely the men who came up from Egypt, from twenty years old and upward, shall not see the land that I swore to Abraham, to Isaac, and to Jacob, because they did not follow Me wholeheartedly,
verses.32:12: except Caleb son of Jephunneh the Kenizzite and Joshua son of Nun, because they followed the LORD wholeheartedly.'
verses.32:13: So the anger of the LORD burned against Israel, and He made them wander in the wilderness for forty years, until the whole generation that had done evil in the eyes of the LORD came to an end.
verses.32:14: And look, you have risen up in place of your fathers, a breed of sinful men, to add yet more to the burning anger of the LORD against Israel.
verses.32:15: If you turn back from following Him, He will once again leave them in the wilderness, and you will ruin all this people."
verses.32:16: Then they approached him and said, "We will build sheepfolds for our livestock here and cities for our little ones,
verses.32:17: but as for us, we will arm ourselves in haste ahead of the sons of Israel until we have brought them to their place, and our little ones will dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
verses.32:18: We will not return to our houses until the sons of Israel have each taken possession of his inheritance.
verses.32:19: For we will not inherit with them across the Jordan and onward, because our inheritance has come to us on the side of the Jordan toward the east."
verses.32:20: Then Moses said to them, "If you do this thing, if you arm yourselves before the LORD for battle,
verses.32:21: and every armed man among you crosses the Jordan before the LORD until He has driven out His enemies from before Him,
verses.32:22: and the land is subdued before the LORD, then afterward you may return, and you will be free of guilt toward the LORD and toward Israel; and this land shall be yours for a possession before the LORD.
verses.32:23: But if you do not do so, look, you have sinned against the LORD, and know that your sin will find you.
verses.32:24: Build for yourselves cities for your little ones and folds for your flocks, and you shall do what has gone out from your mouth."
verses.32:25: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben spoke to Moses, saying, "Your servants will do as my lord commands.
verses.32:26: Our little ones, our wives, our livestock, and all our animals will be there in the cities of Gilead,
verses.32:27: but your servants will cross over, every man armed for warfare, before the LORD for battle, as my lord speaks."
verses.32:28: So concerning them, Moses commanded Eleazar the priest, Joshua son of Nun, and the heads of the fathers' houses of the tribes of the sons of Israel.
verses.32:29: And Moses said to them, "If the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben cross the Jordan with you, every man armed for battle before the LORD, and the land is subdued before you, then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession.
verses.32:30: But if they do not cross over with you armed, then they shall take possession among you in the land of Canaan."
verses.32:31: Then the sons of Gad and the sons of Reuben answered, saying, "What the LORD has spoken to your servants, so we will do.
verses.32:32: We will cross over armed before the LORD into the land of Canaan, and the possession of our inheritance shall be with us across the Jordan."
verses.32:33: So Moses gave to them—the sons of Gad, the sons of Reuben, and the half-tribe of Manasseh son of Joseph—the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land according to its cities with their borders, the cities of the land all around.
verses.32:34: And the sons of Gad built Dibon, Ataroth, Aroer,
verses.32:36: Beth-nimrah, and Beth-haran, fortified cities, and sheepfolds.
verses.32:37: And the sons of Reuben built Heshbon, Elealeh, Kiriathaim,
verses.32:38: Nebo, Baal-meon—with their names changed—and Sibmah; and they gave names to the cities that they built.
verses.32:39: Now the sons of Machir son of Manasseh went to Gilead and captured it, and drove out the Amorites who were in it.
verses.32:40: So Moses gave Gilead to Machir son of Manasseh, and he dwelt in it.
verses.32:41: And Jair son of Manasseh went and captured their tent-villages, and he called them Havvoth-jair.
verses.32:42: And Nobah went and captured Kenath and its daughter towns, and he called it Nobah, by his own name.
verses.33:1: These are the journeys of the sons of Israel, who went out from the land of Egypt according to their divisions, by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
verses.33:2: And Moses wrote down their points of departure according to their journeys at the command of the LORD; and these are their journeys according to their points of departure.
verses.33:3: They departed from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month. On the day after the Passover, the sons of Israel went out with an uplifted hand before the eyes of all the Egyptians.
verses.33:4: Meanwhile, the Egyptians were burying those whom the LORD had struck down among them, every firstborn; and on their gods the LORD executed judgments.
verses.33:5: The sons of Israel departed from Rameses and camped at Succoth.
verses.33:6: They departed from Succoth and camped at Etham, which is at the edge of the wilderness.
verses.33:7: They departed from Etham and turned back to Pi-hahiroth, which faces Baal-zephon, and they camped before Migdol.
verses.33:8: They departed from before Hahiroth and passed through the middle of the sea into the wilderness; then they walked a three-day journey in the wilderness of Etham and camped at Marah.
verses.33:9: They departed from Marah and came to Elim. At Elim there were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees, and they camped there.
verses.33:10: They departed from Elim and camped by the Sea of Reeds.
verses.33:11: They departed from the Sea of Reeds and camped in the wilderness of Sin.
verses.33:12: They departed from the wilderness of Sin and camped at Dophkah.
verses.33:13: They departed from Dophkah and camped at Alush.
verses.33:14: They departed from Alush and camped at Rephidim, and there was no water there for the people to drink.
verses.33:15: They departed from Rephidim and camped in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.33:16: They departed from the wilderness of Sinai and camped at Kibroth-hattaavah.
verses.33:17: They departed from Kibroth-hattaavah and camped at Hazeroth.
verses.33:18: They departed from Hazeroth and camped at Rithmah.
verses.33:19: They departed from Rithmah and camped at Rimmon-perez.
verses.33:20: They departed from Rimmon-perez and camped at Libnah.
verses.33:21: They departed from Libnah and camped at Rissah.
verses.33:22: They departed from Rissah and camped at Kehelathah.
verses.33:23: They departed from Kehelathah and camped at Mount Shepher.
verses.33:24: They departed from Mount Shepher and camped at Haradah.
verses.33:25: They departed from Haradah and camped at Makheloth.
verses.33:26: They departed from Makheloth and camped at Tahath.
verses.33:27: They departed from Tahath and camped at Terah.
verses.33:28: They departed from Terah and camped at Mithkah.
verses.33:29: They departed from Mithkah and camped at Hashmonah.
verses.33:30: They departed from Hashmonah and camped at Moseroth.
verses.33:31: They departed from Moseroth and camped at Bene-jaakan.
verses.33:32: They departed from Bene-jaakan and camped at Hor-haggidgad.
verses.33:33: They departed from Hor-haggidgad and camped at Jotbathah.
verses.33:34: They departed from Jotbathah and camped at Abronah.
verses.33:35: They departed from Abronah and camped at Ezion-geber.
verses.33:36: They departed from Ezion-geber and camped in the wilderness of Zin, that is, Kadesh.
verses.33:37: They departed from Kadesh and camped at Mount Hor, at the edge of the land of Edom.
verses.33:38: Aaron the priest went up to Mount Hor at the command of the LORD and died there, in the fortieth year after the sons of Israel went out from the land of Egypt, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
verses.33:39: And Aaron was one hundred and twenty-three years old at his death on Mount Hor.
verses.33:40: And the Canaanite, the king of Arad, who was dwelling in the Negev in the land of Canaan, heard about the arrival of the sons of Israel.
verses.33:41: They departed from Mount Hor and camped at Zalmonah.
verses.33:42: They departed from Zalmonah and camped at Punon.
verses.33:43: They departed from Punon and camped at Oboth.
